Fellow American,

In times like these, we need leaders who have truly answered the call to serve. **As someone born and raised in Stockton in a proud military family, I didn’t just talk about service – _I lived it._**

I joined the Marine Corps in 2001, trained at the military police academy, and was honored to be recruited by the White House to serve on Marine One, directly supporting the President of the United States amidst some of the most challenging times in our nation's history.

_**My commitment to this nation goes beyond words – I’ve walked the walk, defending the very freedoms we hold dear.**_ My service was genuine and unwavering – something we can’t say for everyone in politics today.

subject: A pretty wild story, if you have a minute
disclaimer_text: Paid for by End Citizens United-Nonfederal
body:
Back when I was that kid sleeping on the floor of our apartment, I never could’ve guessed this is how things would turn out. When I was a Marine in Iraq, I never could’ve guessed that I’d have to fight to defend our democracy at home.
| [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/26910?t=1&akid=21873%2E4449941%2ExZ2cfY)
---
Hola, my friend. It’s Ruben.

You might be wondering how this kid... [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/48536?t=7&akid=21873%2E4449941%2ExZ2cfY) ...ended up here, running for the U.S. Senate, in one of the most competitive races in the entire country. [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/48536?t=8&akid=21873%2E4449941%2ExZ2cfY) Well, it started back in the apartment I shared with my mom and my sisters after our dad left. It was tough. I was sleeping on the floor because that’s all we could afford. [ ]() I knew I had to do whatever it took to build a better life for us. I worked a bunch of jobs all through school to help make ends meet. [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/48536?t=9&akid=21873%2E4449941%2ExZ2cfY) Thanks to my family, my community, and a lot of hard work, I got into college. But before I graduated, I enlisted in the Marines to serve the country that gave me so much. [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/48536?t=10&akid=21873%2E4449941%2ExZ2cfY) I deployed to Al Anbar, Iraq with my brothers in arms. They called us “Lucky Lima”, but our luck turned eventually. We ended up the hardest Marine hit unit of the entire Iraq war, and I lost some of my best friends over there. [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/48536?t=11&akid=21873%2E4449941%2ExZ2cfY) You’re never the same person after something like that. And I knew I had to do something to improve things for the guys I served with, for people who grew up like me. So, I ended up running for Congress — and I won. [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/48536?t=12&akid=21873%2E4449941%2ExZ2cfY) Then, on January 6th, everything changed. It became clear to me that public service wasn’t just about improving the lives of the people in my community anymore — it was about defending our democracy, too. [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/48536?t=13&akid=21873%2E4449941%2ExZ2cfY) So now, I’m running for the U.S. Senate. My opponent Kari Lake continues to spread the same lies and conspiracies that caused January 6th in the first place, and she’s one of the greatest threats to our democracy — after Trump himself. [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/48536?t=14&akid=21873%2E4449941%2ExZ2cfY) Back when I was that kid sleeping on the floor of our apartment, I never would’ve guessed this is how things would turn out.

When I was a Marine in Iraq, I never would’ve thought I’d have to fight to defend our democracy at home.

When I launched my first campaign, I never would’ve imagined that hundreds of thousands of people would back me up and donate to support me, either.

And I never, ever would’ve thought I’d need to ask supporters like you, people who have already done so much, to do a bit more. But to defeat Kari Lake and win in Arizona, that’s what I have to do.

I need you to do a bit more. [**Please — if you can afford to make a split donation of $10 or anything you can to Fight for Reform, to help them elect state and local Democrats, and my campaign, it would mean the world. A fundraising deadline is right around the corner, and we’ve got a ton of progress to make on our goals between now and then.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/48536?t=15&akid=21873%2E4449941%2ExZ2cfY) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Fight for Reform and Ruben Gallego will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/48537?t=16&akid=21873%2E4449941%2ExZ2cfY)
---
[CONTRIBUTE $25 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/48538?t=17&akid=21873%2E4449941%2ExZ2cfY)
[CONTRIBUTE $50 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/48539?t=18&akid=21873%2E4449941%2ExZ2cfY)
[CONTRIBUTE $100 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/48540?t=19&akid=21873%2E4449941%2ExZ2cfY)
[Or a custom donation »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/48536?t=20&akid=21873%2E4449941%2ExZ2cfY)
Thank you. I couldn’t do this without you and the team we’ve built together.

Semper Fi,

Ruben

Legal Troubles Continue To Mount For Candidate With 22 Criminal Charges | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/09de7735ff62/video-scott-baugh-served-with-cease-and-desist-16200016?e=7017cc100e)

| | **For Immediate Release:** August 12, 2024
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**VIDEO: SCOTT BAUGH SERVED WITH CEASE AND DESIST**
_Legal Troubles Continue To Mount For Candidate With 22 Criminal Charges_
**IRVINE, CA** — Congressional candidate Scott Baugh’s legal woes continued, as he was served a [cease and desist letter](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=683068a2bd&e=7017cc100e) for patently false advertising against his general election opponent, State Senator Dave Min. Baugh is no stranger to legal proceedings, having been indicted for over twenty criminal charges (including four felony counts) for...
* [Fraud](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=ef1ca9b7f8&e=7017cc100e)
* [Perjury](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=5c4d478d3e&e=7017cc100e)
* [Nine separate instances of violating campaign finance laws](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=575d23e5e6&e=7017cc100e)

Baugh also oversaw the largest voter fraud scandal in Orange County history, as he served as Chair of the Orange County Republican Party during a massive criminal voter registration conspiracy that led to at least [three employees pleading guilty to felony voter fraud charges](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=66e2f0df83&e=7017cc100e).
**[](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=f0101c70f4&e=7017cc100e)**
**“Baugh is a crook and a liar who is running a campaign centered around his loyalty to a dangerous Presidential ticket,”** said Dan Driscoll, Min’s campaign manager. **“He has no policies, no platform, no ideas on how to keep Orange County families safe. His campaign is grasping at straws and resorting to flat out lies – but Dave Min has the experience, law enforcement support and record necessary to uphold the rule of law in Orange County and Washington D.C.”**

Baugh's advertisement that Senator Min supports Prop 47 is demonstrably false. Indeed, Min’s staunch support for the initiative to repeal Prop 47 was lauded by leading law enforcement organizations:
**_“Dave Min has been a trusted partner with Police Officers and law enforcement in fighting crime and improving public safety across California and Orange County. We stand with him in his support for fixing Proposition 47 and addressing the problem of retail theft in this state.”_**

\- Craig Lally, President of the California Coalition of Law Enforcement Agents

**_“The Association of Orange County Deputy Sheriffs appreciate Dave Min’s leadership in supporting law enforcement and working toward keeping our communities safer from crime, and we strongly support him in trying to fix Proposition 47.”_**

\- Juan Viramontes, President of the Association of Orange County Deputy Sheriffs
In addition to being on the DCCC’s Red to Blue List of priority challengers for the House, Senator Min is endorsed by outgoing Rep. Katie Porter and over 50 local elected officials. **He is the consensus choice of Police–having been endorsed by PORAC, CA FOP, LAPPL and AOCDS** –as well as Teachers, Firefighters, and Organized Labor, with major endorsements including the National Education Association, the American Federation of Teachers, the International Association of Firefighters, SEIU, AFSCME, Teamsters, AFL-CIO, and the California Labor Federation. A full endorsement list is available [here](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=e546122ad8&e=7017cc100e).
###

_California’s 47th is an open_[ _DCCC Red To Blue_](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=e8b8ae8bbd&e=7017cc100e) _Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Democratic Representative Katie Porter is not running for re-election. clean_body: Tim isn’t the only one who knows their way around the fairgrounds | = Folks, I just HAD to show you this. = Tim isn’t the only one who knows their way around the state fair. This weekend I stopped by AG Day at the state fair and got to hang out with this adorable piglet and engage with the voters in Springfield. Fighting for farms, farmers, and cute little pigs like this one is something that I’m proud to do every single day in Washington. I’m working alongside House Democrats to pass a Farm Bill that doesn’t undercut farmers and everyday families, ensures that we have solutions to farm sustainably so we don’t exacerbate the climate crisis, and makes sure that family farms have opportunity for success so that people can sustain their livelihoods for generations to come. The reality is that the folks on the other side of the aisle who are working to enact the Project 2025 agenda are working even harder to put a stop to all of that. | | “If the Heritage Foundation had its way, the next President would demand that Congresssignificantly cut federally supported crop insurance, eliminate the Conservation Reserve Program, phase out certain H-2 work visas, and repeal agricultural export promotion programs like USDA’s Market Access Program. AP: Federal appeals court deals a blow to Voting Rights Act, ruling that private plaintiffs can’t sue [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=081424_1&amount=25]
The recent 8th Circuit ruling is one of the most dangerous anti-voter rulings we’ve seen in years . In the eight states impacted by the ruling, voters and voting rights organizations can no longer sue to overturn unjust laws under the Voting Rights Act.
In plain language -- pro-voting lawsuits brought in states like Wisconsin, Georgia, Florida, and others nationwide wouldn't be possible anymore if the Supreme Court backs up this ruling and gets rid of the "private right of action".
We won’t sugarcoat this: That ruling could be a crushing blow to many voting rights organizations, including Voter Action Project. If this ruling is not overturned by a higher court, it could unravel all of the great work organizations like ours are doing across the country — and allow dozens of unjust, unconstitutional voter restrictions to stand.
This attack on the Voting Rights Act highlights the importance of the other work we’ll do over the next year, as well: Voter registration, education, mobilization and more. As voter suppression laws become increasingly targeted and oppressive , our work to combat them must become smarter, stronger and more accessible to everyone.
Team, we have to fight harder than ever to protect the right to vote in 2024. Please pitch in $25 or whatever you can to stand with us in a crucial moment >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=081424_1&amount=25]

clean_body: AP: Federal appeals court deals a blow to Voting Rights Act, ruling that private plaintiffs can’t sue [] The recent 8th Circuit ruling is one of the most dangerous anti-voter rulings we’ve seen in years . In the eight states impacted by the ruling, voters and voting rights organizations can no longer sue to overturn unjust laws under the Voting Rights Act. In plain language -- pro-voting lawsuits brought in states like Wisconsin, Georgia, Florida, and others nationwide wouldn't be possible anymore if the Supreme Court backs up this ruling and gets rid of the "private right of action". We won’t sugarcoat this: That ruling could be a crushing blow to many voting rights organizations, including Voter Action Project. If this ruling is not overturned by a higher court, it could unravel all of the great work organizations like ours are doing across the country — and allow dozens of unjust, unconstitutional voter restrictions to stand. This attack on the Voting Rights Act highlights the importance of the other work we’ll do over the next year, as well: Voter registration, education, mobilization and more. As voter suppression laws become increasingly targeted and oppressive , our work to combat them must become smarter, stronger and more accessible to everyone. Team, we have to fight harder than ever to protect the right to vote in 2024. Peter,
**John Goodman is a born-and-raised Missourian who knows real family values.**
He learned them the same way I did, by growing up in a beautiful community where people took care of each other — through good times and tough times.
**_[Watch this message from John Goodman, then please chip in $10 to help me replace Josh Hawley and restore real family values in the Senate >>>](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/66632?refcode=em20240814-7347&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7347%2E614464%2EyYbpio)_**

He wrote a weird self-help book called “Manhood,” lecturing all of us about how we need to be made in his own creepy image. He’s enriched himself while failing to bring ANY money home for the rest of our state. He forced Missouri taxpayers to foot the $250,000 bill for his own lawbreaking. Hawley doesn’t want to represent us — he just wants to rule us. He wants to control how we build and raise our families. He wants to control what happens in our bedroom, in our workplace, in our doctor’s office, and even our bodies.

name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: Only a few days left to VOTE! ✅ / ¡Quedan pocos días para VOTAR! ✅
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
VOTE NOW to get TOP to the SXSW 2025 stage
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Smaller%20TOP%20SXSW%20graphic%202025.jpg]
GO VOTE NOW: TOP has submitted a panel proposal for SXSW 2025 — "Art & Culture as Catalysts for Progressive Movement Building," featuring rapper and activist Tef Poe!
We know that key in our efforts to build a democracy in Texas that looks like us and shares our values, our ideas have to inspire change and be creatively shared. Being selected to participate in SXSW 2025 is one way we see shaping the larger cultural conversation about civic engagement.
Community voting for SXSW panel proposals started Tuesday, August 6, and runs through THIS SUNDAY, August 18.
It just takes a minute to vote!
1. Go to https://panelpicker.sxsw.com/ [https://panelpicker.sxsw.com/]
2. Click “SIGN IN” if you already have an account, or click the “CREATE ACCOUNT” button at the bottom to make a new one. Fill out the fields and submit.
3. Go to your email inbox, open the SXSW email, and click the “Confirm my account” link.
4. On the home page, click “Search Proposals.” In the search bar, type “Art & Culture as Catalysts for Progressive Movement Building"
5. Click on the proposal name, and in the top right corner click the up arrow to vote!
Abbott is at it again...
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Abbott%20immigration%20executive%20order%20hospitals.jpg]
This past Thursday, Gov. Greg Abbott issued an alarming executive order instructing hospitals to collect data on patients' immigration status. [https://www.texastribune.org/2024/08/08/texas-public-hospitals-immigration-status-patients/] Time and time again, Abbott politically scapegoats immigrants to distract from his policy failures.
Separating and dehumanizing members of our communities – people who are our family, friends, and neighbors – is straight out of the MAGA playbook. As his idol Donald Trump flails in the polls, struggling to connect with his racist, backwards vision for our country, Gov. Abbott is more than ready to demonize fellow Texans, because just like Trump he views Black and Brown immigrants as lesser than.
Hospitals should serve peoples’ health needs, not operate as intrusive immigration checkpoints. Healthcare is a human right. Each and every person in our state deserves to have that right upheld.
If Greg Abbott honestly cared about saving our state money while improving the health of Texans, he would have expanded our Medicaid program in 2015 , his first year as governor. This reckless executive order will put the health of everyday Texans’ at risk, as it’s intended to stoke fear and uncertainty in the more than 1.5 million undocumented immigrants who call this state home. As Texans, we care for each other and look out for each other – no matter the color of our skin, the language we speak, or our documentation status. We are NOT letting our governor divide us.
Honoring Sonya Massey, breaking bread, and building community in Dallas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Sonya%20Massey%20vigil%20and%20cookout.jpg]
TOP staff and members proudly teamed up with the SERUN Foundation, Child Poverty Action Lab, and Stop Cop City for a community cookout and vigil in memory of Sonya Massey [https://www.salon.com/2024/07/27/sonya-massey-underscores-disproportionate-police-violence-against-black-and-disabled-people/] over the weekend in South Dallas.
In addition to the vigil remembering Black and Latino lives cut short by police brutality, community members picked up valuable knowledge on tenants' rights and TOP's vision for housing justice.
Our thanks to all who attended and made this an evening of deepening our solidarity and building power!
Contact Iman at ibouzid@organizetexas.org [ibouzid@organizetexas.org] for more information on ways you can plug in to TOP's housing justice work in Dallas.
TOP Tips: Get ahead of COVID this school semester
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Latino%20School%20bus%20family.jpg]
Millions of students across Texas have returned to classrooms to kick off the fall semester. Just as this summer's COVID spike has shown, the virus is still active in our communities, meaning we have to keep our guard up and continue to look out for the health of others. Here's what parents need to know about COVID as kids get ready to start the new school year. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/08/02/health/virus-covid-school-flu-children-testing-symptoms-wellness/index.html]
Español
VOTA AHORA para enviar TOP al SXSW 2025
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Smaller%20TOP%20SXSW%20graphic%202025.jpg]
SALGA A VOTAR AHORA: TOP ha presentado una propuesta de panel para SXSW 2025: "Arte y cultura como catalizadores para la construcción del movimiento progresista," con el rapero y activista Tef Poe.
Sabemos que, para construir una democracia en Texas que se parezca a nosotros y comparta nuestros valores, nuestras ideas deben inspirar el cambio y compartirse creativamente. Ser seleccionados para participar en SXSW 2025 es una forma en que vemos moldear la conversación cultural más amplia sobre la participación cívica.
La votación de la comunidad para las propuestas del panel SXSW comenzó el martes 6 de agosto y se extenderá hasta el 18 de agosto, ESTE DOMINGO.
¡Solo toma un minuto votar!
1. Vaya a https://panelpicker.sxsw.com/ [https://panelpicker.sxsw.com/]
2. Haga clic en "SIGN IN" si ya tiene una cuenta, o haga clic en el botón "CREATE ACCOUNT" en la parte inferior para crear una nueva. Complete la forma y envíe.
3. Vaya a la bandeja de entrada de su correo electrónico, abra el correo electrónico de SXSW y haga clic en el enlace "Confirm my account."
4. En la página de inicio, haga clic en "Search Proposals." En la barra de búsqueda, escriba " Art & Culture as Catalysts for Progressive Movement Building ."
5. Haga clic en el nombre de la propuesta y, en la esquina superior derecha, haga clic en la flecha hacia arriba para votar.
Abbott vuelve a hacerlo...
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Abbott%20immigration%20executive%20order%20hospitals.jpg]
El jueves pasado, el gobernador Greg Abbott emitió una orden ejecutiva alarmante que instruía a los hospitales a recopilar datos sobre el estado migratorio de los pacientes. [https://www.univision.com/local/austin-kakw/texas-hospitales-informacion-inmigrantes-indocumentados] Una y otra vez, Abbott utiliza políticamente a los inmigrantes como chivos expiatorios para distraer la atención de sus fracasos políticos.
Separar y deshumanizar a los miembros de nuestras comunidades (personas que son nuestra familia, amigos y vecinos) está sacado directamente del manual de estrategia del MAGA. Mientras su ídolo Donald Trump se pa bajo en las encuestas, luchando por conectarse con su visión racista y retrógrada de nuestro país, el gobernador Abbott está más que dispuesto a demonizar a sus compañeros tejanos, porque, al igual que Trump, considera que los inmigrantes negros y morenos son inferiores.
Los hospitales deben atender las necesidades de salud de las personas, no funcionar como puntos de control de inmigración intrusivos. La cuidad de salud es un derecho humano. Todas y cada una de las personas en nuestro estado merecen que se respete ese derecho.
Si Greg Abbott se preocupara honestamente por ahorrar dinero a nuestro estado y al mismo tiempo mejorar la salud de los tejanos, habría ampliado nuestro programa Medicaid en 2015 , su primer año como gobernador. Esta imprudente orden ejecutiva pondrá en riesgo la salud de los tejanos comunes y corrientes, ya que tiene como objetivo avivar el miedo y la incertidumbre en los más de 1,5 millones de inmigrantes indocumentados que llaman hogar a este estado. Como tejanos, nos cuidamos unos a otros, sin importar el color de nuestra piel, el idioma que hablamos o nuestro estado de documentación. NO vamos a permitir que nuestro gobernador nos divida.
Honrando a Sonya Massey, partiendo el pan, y construyendo comunidad en Dallas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Sonya%20Massey%20vigil%20and%20cookout.jpg]
El personal y los miembros de TOP se asociaron con orgullo con la Fundación SERUN, Child Poverty Action Lab y Stop Cop City para una comida comunitaria y una vigilia en memoria de Sonya Massey [https://www.salon.com/2024/07/27/sonya-massey-underscores-disproportionate-police-violence-against-black-and-disabled-people/] el sábado pasado en el sur de Dallas.
Además de la vigilia para recordar las vidas de los negros y latinos fallecios por la brutalidad policial, los miembros de la comunidad adquirieron conocimientos valiosos sobre los derechos de los inquilinos y la visión de TOP para la justicia en materia de vivienda.
¡Nuestro agradecimiento a todos los que asistieron e hicieron de esta una noche para profundizar nuestra solidaridad y construir poder!
Comuníquese con Iman en ibouzid@organizetexas.org [ibouzid@organizetexas.org] para obtener más información sobre las formas en que puede conectarse al trabajo de justicia de vivienda de TOP en Dallas.
Consejos de TOP: Adelántese del COVID este semestre escolar

subject: Big Tech Fears the Babylon Bee’s Jokes
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.-A1IQfydg8rCEY9VhgBA)
---
|
---
Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: "Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor."
---
[](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.-tLm-Q)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It 's clear to us that what the censors want is submission. **They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and stop fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They're asking us if we're willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier.** ****Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.**** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers.** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)**** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---
[**YES, I'LL STAND WITH THE BEE**](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)
---
Thanks for standing with us. We will continue to stand with you. Sincerely,Seth Dillon
CEO, The Babylon Bee

name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: The Connection Between Faith and Freedom
body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years—which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zphk2fq56626u8co7kr8t3imvjs06jlnl4f24rk8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6cti66p31cth2bs) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zdg79eor26ketobc4j8kr7em3aalrkobckjh1tg8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6cti66p31cth2bs) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z29ladm9e50rq8elr9lq51c3pftvjq09m836o050_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6cti66p31cth2bs) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| 1600 Daily

subject: Consider....
body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years—which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z8v9ah5oslcfblaqpstb5r9ejg46a6iuvejs5sh0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6cti6eo72clh2bs) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z7e4g07b7h9uhou5cllofjk9t1k0r4ojju6nju48_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6cti6eo72clh2bs) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zpr8vf2o4abvnecq1gdrc7kb0t75ombhpef057qg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6cti6eo72clh2bs) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| Your America

body:
This is probably the hardest email I’ve ever written.

| |
---
| | | | | | | | Friend \--
I wish things would have gone a different way... | **_Democrat Vicente Gonzalez holds back Republican surge, returns 34th Congressional District to Democratic control._**
---

This is probably the hardest email I've ever written.

**I 'm Mayra Flores, the America First Hispanic woman running in the biggest race in the nation.**

After we made history and flipped a blue seat red for the first time in 100 years, the Democrats threw the kitchen sink at me, **and I had to concede my race. **

[](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z5sru5ntk7nfrlo4eps4g9388e8bilj6f5ffsfa0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6cth68ob0clh2bs)

---
Everyone expected me to just walk away - _but I 'm not someone who ever, ever gives up._

I'm taking a leap of faith here and have thrown my name on the ballot once again.

The Democrats overpowered us in this race before - _and now all indicators are pointing toward this election being a complete toss-up._

My stomach is in knots - **the Democrats have already raised an astonishing $30 MILLION, and Kamala Harris just raised $100 million bucks**(I know, I can't believe anyone would give her money either...but they do).

**That 's why I'm humbly asking for your help: _[Will you step up and chip in just a few bucks in the next hour to help us counter this massive Left-wing onslaught?](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z6cncotqemnio766908hm1edgemolbr30ndnjue0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6cth68ob0clh2bs "Will you step up and chip in just a few bucks in the next hour to help us counter this massive Left-wing onslaught?")_**

I'll just tell you: I'm afraid to see what happens if this email doesn't work.

**The Democrats & the media hacks are terrified of me - that's because as a young Hispanic female, I obliterate every woke narrative they push. So, they will truly do anything to destroy me.**

The Democrats know that if they lose the Hispanic vote, it's over for them. _Forever._

I'm opening my heart to you here: Please, please help out:
| | | [**CONTRIBUTE**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2ztc347141962iddio7bodpt30b6rhdlsgci9l280_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6cth68ob0clh2bs)
---
God bless you, and God bless America.

**Mayra Flores**
America First Candidate
Texas Congressional District 34

name: Hillsdale College via Conservative Broadcast
subject: National Referendum on Religious Liberty
body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years—which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from Conservative Broadcast is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/pihrwWR9tWHornkdB9P2EA~~/AARclAA~/RgRooExuP0SwaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3JlbGlnaW91cy1saWJlcnR5LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEyNTNOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJlbGlnaW91c2xpYmVydHlzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtQ0ItMjAyNDA4MTVXA3NwY0IKZruusr1mw0ITEFIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/pihrwWR9tWHornkdB9P2EA~~/AARclAA~/RgRooExuP0SwaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3JlbGlnaW91cy1saWJlcnR5LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEyNTNOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJlbGlnaW91c2xpYmVydHlzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtQ0ItMjAyNDA4MTVXA3NwY0IKZruusr1mw0ITEFIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. name: Jim Carris
subject: Our Families Deserve Safety—Join Me in Supporting Law Enforcement in IL-10
body:
Peter,

Across Illinois' 10th District, too many families no longer feel safe. Crimes that once seemed **rare and distant** now occur far too often and right in our backyards. Parents worry about their children's safety, and neighbors look out for each other with a sense of unease. Meanwhile, our police departments face a national recruitment crisis, struggling to fill the ranks with officers who protect our communities. Those officers who do choose to put their uniforms on every day **face heartbreak and danger daily** , often in ways most of us will never experience. Yet, they continue to protect and serve with **unwavering dedication**.Last Friday, I had the honor of participating in a ridealong with the Waukegan Police Department. The experience left an indelible mark on me. **I witnessed firsthand the immense challenges our officers face daily and saw their unwavering dedication to keeping our communities safe.** What I saw inspired me to write an op-ed as a testament to how hard our police officers and first responders work. **They deserve not only our respect but also our full support to ensure they have the resources, training, and community connections needed to do their jobs effectively.** [CLICK HERE TO READ MY OP-ED](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sljdujt-tlidtddjku-r/) As your candidate for Illinois' 10th Congressional District, **I 'm running to restore respect for law enforcement and advocate for policies that fund our police, expand training opportunities, and build stronger relationships between officers and the communities they serve.** But I can't do this alone.

Your contribution--whether it's $25, $50, or $100--will help us spread this message and reach more voters in Illinois' 10th District. **Together, we can build a safer future for our families and communities.** [PLEASE DONATE $25 TODAY](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sljdujt-tlidtddjku-y/) Thank you for your support, Jim Carris [](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sljdujt-tlidtddjku-j/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sljdujt-tlidtddjku-t/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sljdujt-tlidtddjku-i/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sljdujt-tlidtddjku-d/) [ Share ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-fb-sljdujt-tlidtddjku-h/) [ Tweet ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-tw-sljdujt-tlidtddjku-k/) [ Share ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-li-sljdujt-tlidtddjku-u/) [ Forward ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.forwardtomyfriend.com/t-tlidtddjku-FE53F914-sljdujt-l-o) | [Unsubscribe](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-u-sljdujt-tlidtddjku-m/)

essential to the good practice of law.

Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father's
cabin, and did not return until he could "give any proposition in
the six books of Euclid at sight."

By
studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly-plus,
in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.

That's
why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the

body:
I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...

This sponsored message from Conservative Liberty Wire is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=393cdde309904f95bff708ac2fefe101&_e=SgokgQGHLlmZaTsxYSKEMd9DQA08IMjGx8pFqPQ28grDJjH7OjrYahNrLx3hfSNlzu5BXowxOlYlQlfvUdQbfxO0EylkOJnPck_6oZJt9PKXY-jG9KsGFe3jRK8yl2XhvNCroPHIP6zgqXZINuYQA1SKppm9bqDkBKdjCMoT5TgF55LLeexSqeTknVXo6riOca6x8p3lkwm1TlWSjf3KaSXaaoKd7SodHg3KKX4uWCgrcG5LRKmFn7bzh8DDd-q7JDDEl1mxe5cXLzFmLOaPcWEbgHULu5QE05FqltttjgLOCwfyYq8pK8x6CeBPBusRqnpt9fvQsd5pYcg1dinBfp1COvdC4Bf_2jC8pJUCzDVCeJinXjHBJhA7nETrkpleUaSrGuAMXuqfaN3kHYierg%3D%3D) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country... Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.
Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.
The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in "extremist ideologies" and having the potential for "domestic terrorism."
Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted. **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=393cdde309904f95bff708ac2fefe101&_e=SgokgQGHLlmZaTsxYSKEMd9DQA08IMjGx8pFqPQ28grDJjH7OjrYahNrLx3hfSNlzu5BXowxOlYlQlfvUdQbfxO0EylkOJnPck_6oZJt9PKXY-jG9KsGFe3jRK8yl2XhvNCroPHIP6zgqXZINuYQA1SKppm9bqDkBKdjCMoT5TgF55LLeexSqeTknVXo6riOca6x8p3lkwm1TlWSjf3KaSXaaoKd7SodHg3KKX4uWCgrcG5LRKmFn7bzh8DDd-q7aHPbE9HtubDadgKRq084STa3rGeDC2jXwinzqxl7K3dUZIvWBScXogo87bICOrZM1MW7NPpVBP9U5smVGjsiADvRq5YQI1LaELo70g_hJgxMjZ6HVG88n0awoK40EyvI5jH6Aa3mrLmqmcUtabn7jw%3D%3D) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include: **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide. After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=393cdde309904f95bff708ac2fefe101&_e=SgokgQGHLlmZaTsxYSKEMd9DQA08IMjGx8pFqPQ28grDJjH7OjrYahNrLx3hfSNlzu5BXowxOlYlQlfvUdQbfxO0EylkOJnPck_6oZJt9PKXY-jG9KsGFe3jRK8yl2XhvNCroPHIP6zgqXZINuYQA1SKppm9bqDkBKdjCMoT5TgF55LLeexSqeTknVXo6riOca6x8p3lkwm1TlWSjf3KaSXaaoKd7SodHg3KKX4uWCgrcG5LRKmFn7bzh8DDd-q7TiOIYuNQ1z0DNSlwJVXQ1kn0dzrktyLBkacURIawqUSUbe975b8VB9yklJjnjAqxEcn68u6F8Wl7I_1a5XDdiaR9JuXfFaWjiK50f69MUmmB7auiS5hbFhJqENfwDZzB4YHadSw3EbLssyk0j2Gouw%3D%3D) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

subject: National Referendum on Religious Liberty
body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years—which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from Inside Scoop Politics is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyUkUuL2zAQgH-NfLORR3asHHwIeAOF7raQQ49GlkbOgF5I8pb99yVttve9zuP75vHrdX1V5Cjsb8rjTKWsuaxBrXdyrrTlyO_40YbYkt9X4DC0XLb9uPaNmUfopZUNzv0EYgIOXDT3Gc04aI1nu2kDQmqp7GimzRq-KWX7qaH5weGyH_l5mGDq4Cw3sCc7KCEHaTkb-JGMqthRKGSw6BhTio4q6dLFvDduvteaChMXBlcGV5e6v_Ma5bBDczC4ZnS0UzxK62jDXD-euzwaxLVoJhbewyjeOAzwnV-WH8vLy43B6ah-LfHIGplYUo4loa4U9mfKo6HDM7GgV-SeQa18UrQHJpb_3qf20_qvLoaKoTKx_Ly032639vMSTZ5N-k3OUTlNbOD7A97p6Jv6lZ-8z_AnAAD__7trmK0) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyUkUuL2zAQgH-NfLORR3asHHwIeAOF7raQQ49GlkbOgF5I8pb99yVttve9zuP75vHrdX1V5Cjsb8rjTKWsuaxBrXdyrrTlyO_40YbYkt9X4DC0XLb9uPaNmUfopZUNzv0EYgIOXDT3Gc04aI1nu2kDQmqp7GimzRq-KWX7qaH5weGyH_l5mGDq4Cw3sCc7KCEHaTkb-JGMqthRKGSw6BhTio4q6dLFvDduvteaChMXBlcGV5e6v_Ma5bBDczC4ZnS0UzxK62jDXD-euzwaxLVoJhbewyjeOAzwnV-WH8vLy43B6ah-LfHIGplYUo4loa4U9mfKo6HDM7GgV-SeQa18UrQHJpb_3qf20_qvLoaKoTKx_Ly032639vMSTZ5N-k3OUTlNbOD7A97p6Jv6lZ-8z_AnAAD__7trmK0) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyUkUuL2zAQgH-NfLORR3asHHwIeAOF7raQQ49GlkbOgF5I8pb99yVttve9zuP75vHrdX1V5Cjsb8rjTKWsuaxBrXdyrrTlyO_40YbYkt9X4DC0XLb9uPaNmUfopZUNzv0EYgIOXDT3Gc04aI1nu2kDQmqp7GimzRq-KWX7qaH5weGyH_l5mGDq4Cw3sCc7KCEHaTkb-JGMqthRKGSw6BhTio4q6dLFvDduvteaChMXBlcGV5e6v_Ma5bBDczC4ZnS0UzxK62jDXD-euzwaxLVoJhbewyjeOAzwnV-WH8vLy43B6ah-LfHIGplYUo4loa4U9mfKo6HDM7GgV-SeQa18UrQHJpb_3qf20_qvLoaKoTKx_Ly032639vMSTZ5N-k3OUTlNbOD7A97p6Jv6lZ-8z_AnAAD__7trmK0) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open. Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation. The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.” Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted. That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty. By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the National Referendum on Religious Liberty by using the secure link below: Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty." Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. The first step is ...EDUCATION. Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is reaching and teaching millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our Project to Save Religious Liberty in America. These efforts include: Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country. Distributing Imprimis , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty. Providing a classical K-12 curriculum with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide. After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the National Referendum on Religious Liberty and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to reach and teach millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies. America
gave him a Purple Heart and I gave him my whole heart.

I first
met Sam Brown in the burn unit. He'd just returned from
Afghanistan where he and his soldiers were ambushed by the
Taliban.

He was
injured by a roadside bomb and had a long road to recovery. I was
assigned as his dietitian in rehab and was very impressed by him.

Here was
a young man terribly injured while serving his country, but his
heart was full of faith.

He fought
with every fiber of his being to recover so he could return to
serve with his men in Afghanistan.

And even
when it became clear that he would never be permitted to return
to the line of duty on account of his injuries, he didn't skip a
beat.

Sam had
to relearn everything. He had prepared for his entire life to
spend his career fighting for his country in the military. After
his life plans were dashed in just 60 seconds, he re-focused his
vision on serving others in a new way.

Before we
were married, and before we were even dating, Sam and I became
friends. I shared with him some of the struggles I had faced, and
he was honest with me. He was concerned for my Salvation - and
for that matter so was I.

He
challenged me to reconnect with God and start going to church
again. As he and I grew closer, he helped me rediscover my faith.

Now here
we are 15 years later. We have 3 kids, I'm a Bible-believing
momma, and Sam is running for Senate to keep serving our nation
and restore hope, leadership, and accountability.

I'm
endlessly grateful that God put him in my life. Sam is a warrior,
a hero, a leader.

I'm
backing this Purple Heart veteran all the way and I hope you will
too.

Thank you
for your consideration,

Captain
Amy Brown
U.S.
Army, ret.

P.S. - If
you feel so led, Sam could use your financial support. He's
closer than ever to winning his Toss-Up race and flipping the
Senate majority. Like many of you, we live on a fixed income. But
campaign expenses are piling up and we have to dig deeper to go
all the way. Anything you can spare will be most appreciated.

DONATE
NOW

Sam Brown

titles, and photographs in uniform does not imply endorsement of
the United States Army or the Department of Defense.

body:
I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...

This sponsored message from Full Mag News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b93508402e8e4619b8cb72f9bbf4f0ee&_e=Ty3yILz9q11iKA_ZbWTYDqBoUWuVV8bdKe9mb6gkV7grM-OBdiQcOBx3gB5SuSkNv76SvHaGZEpuCj0Q9MW4RRCNI1xhFPS4kVz-fNc0lMXCG5ENfO0Rx-CEDk5dTsZVKLpUs7_7oMeVuID-snGt_zc2t0z9mOo9SxLlU2pWDdla00QBNF96s_NCsj2yzBidFBr3Dz3W-n2jHu3B8OymKPwgyEL5_pyyDMW55jykqTx6ILXRyDxU_-dC7NJXhyz-9w7YKwR05p4zvCPxLqVa2v5WzgJjpjRAM1r695zH_71rHbzNkGWPse7McSeugDW5WdbyH4CFSNy_oBmWU3-Q3xDwFa90Y40WQD4Uxq7hmjyB_YEYTJQrKV9FitUR956ebGpFeM1WwhYO2uGUj1WZ-g%3D%3D) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country... Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.
Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.
The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in "extremist ideologies" and having the potential for "domestic terrorism."
Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted. **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b93508402e8e4619b8cb72f9bbf4f0ee&_e=Ty3yILz9q11iKA_ZbWTYDqBoUWuVV8bdKe9mb6gkV7grM-OBdiQcOBx3gB5SuSkNv76SvHaGZEpuCj0Q9MW4RRCNI1xhFPS4kVz-fNc0lMXCG5ENfO0Rx-CEDk5dTsZVKLpUs7_7oMeVuID-snGt_zc2t0z9mOo9SxLlU2pWDdla00QBNF96s_NCsj2yzBidFBr3Dz3W-n2jHu3B8OymKPwgyEL5_pyyDMW55jykqTx6ILXRyDxU_-dC7NJXhyz-6mj_b5B8-C2X5eEZ0pLFwPJyteBvnFqpV2f0zr3l62mLuey7UdbdDvCwKWszAk26e6mQcYIQAgcLYxJUUvboMyvEPxlsrEKsw2dgY0fd7io6GBeYebb2ucpHpR0GFDTBQi6jMefIBLyTTBtFkrZDog%3D%3D) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include: **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide. After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b93508402e8e4619b8cb72f9bbf4f0ee&_e=Ty3yILz9q11iKA_ZbWTYDqBoUWuVV8bdKe9mb6gkV7grM-OBdiQcOBx3gB5SuSkNv76SvHaGZEpuCj0Q9MW4RRCNI1xhFPS4kVz-fNc0lMXCG5ENfO0Rx-CEDk5dTsZVKLpUs7_7oMeVuID-snGt_zc2t0z9mOo9SxLlU2pWDdla00QBNF96s_NCsj2yzBidFBr3Dz3W-n2jHu3B8OymKPwgyEL5_pyyDMW55jykqTx6ILXRyDxU_-dC7NJXhyz-pgGU2jvKhn9zI8Fiqh7XTYuxUHfYrURW89Xv4xg5CadPGWam-bjDyasxwzwMSF1VKyKsYrOWGKBubkz_6btWTr0AB_tPl0t4Zx0-KEVhE560dHprof2437ftfs_K9D62oFEu3MJIegt1mffGeoupHQ%3D%3D) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is reaching and teaching millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.
