## Texas Sues General Motors For Selling Driver Data
Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton has [filed a lawsuit](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGu4yAURL8GdzcCDNguKLZxl223tC7m2kHBxgLiJH-_SqRXvm6kGY2Ozr_rdMUQw77-xY1sfS1pwrmGk6YehAapJtV467gfRENWdLLtpFJD29yscGo20sjZGecW3XmOWjntlfLLoLhqgpVcKt4LLbg2bXdxQgty_dChNp0RyBQnH2rKl3qjSi8sS3ynk_JlTlsT7a3Wo7D2D5MjkyO6WbSfhsnxSKUyOa60U8YIW6opFygP8vD9Aaw15Z3e8DO50w4HvmraYQmRCkR8lkeoMGOGDe-UAWOkNewrhE_ACIXiRw34HE7K4LEik6PQotdcGSbHJlt_PEOMoZiOKb5uGOIXvv7i8rTyfwAAAP__kTN5Lg) against General Motors, alleging that the company illegally collected and sold drivers' data to insurance companies without their consent. The suit claims that GM used technology in car models from 2015 and later to [gather detailed driving data](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO6yAQRb8Gd1gwgLELitfQ5bVbWoMZO2ixiTCKs3-_Svrtr-45Ol-3-YYpp2P7jzu59lrLjEtLT5pHLg0HPesuuiDiJDty0oKyoPWkurtTIcgAcV3NuEihJemIE02TRmODCUOXHAjQYpRGCjMo2wdpJIVxsmgGO0hkWlBMrdS-3anRC881_5Qn1X4pe5fdvbXHydQ_Bp6Bv66rf5ScWlrKe8DAH3SdDPwbw8CLkYGXioH_fPGNDqqY-V5aqSdfsPKIDXmruHynY-NCSKtGa7vq4uNKOadzsEyLbceUPw7tjyRPB78BAAD__zlQYe8) from over 1.8 million Texans and 14 million vehicles, which was then sold to companies that generated "driving scores" for insurance providers. Paxton argues that GM deceived customers by encouraging them to enroll in programs like OnStar Smart Driver without fully disclosing how their data would be used and sold.
## Texas Schools Selected For DOE Project
Two Texas universities have been [selected to participate](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kD2vpSAUAH8Ndhj5Ei0otrG7225pjnjUkyAYYPXef7_Z9-rXzyST-fOaX0CB4v4bTnT1vaUZfKUb54ELw6WedbO6pVtH0aATViortR5Vc7hNbaaH0RvTC29BS6O9RaVArH5Qy9aQk53U3SCM6EyvbLsII3AZRgumt70Apjtcqabc1gMrvqFs4ZNuzK1PZxPcUetVmPrF5MTk9DxPixHz_mn3dDM5behPJifIlXzAwuT0t_AVL8j1xFj5N8wp3lhq4Vrzk0KgFPmV000r8or-iOQhcCiFSoXoke-YQtrJ8wUKxdJkt17Pf7H0luluP4HCV2D94dft5L8AAAD__xgmcU8) in a U.S. Department of Energy project that aims to develop strategies for commercial-scale carbon capture, transport, and storage. [Texas Tech University](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOgzAQRL_GdEb2YrBTuLiGLtdeiWyzBOcAR_YGkr8_kf66kWb0NHo_1-Hq4hK327db0dJrSoMLFHccDJctBzWoarRejBdZoZUaGg1KXZpqtk5I3YkGwgSydWCMEEYrPyHoMAnpq2hBgBJGtlK0XaNrL1uJ3ly0azvdSceUwDFSyjXNSPhyZVreacdch7RWi52JHoU1Xwx6Bv1xHPVv8ONZMuhPNoNeGAa9PNMHwAnDzJ9b3DGXSG9-T3Er_Fn4mLBwpfgalyWmjQeXfdp4oZTdDfkjpzsGYtBX2Y6P41yVTjMlbquLy-cR_SNot_AXAAD__zJOZ3g) and the University of Texas at Austin will each receive a little more than $6.2 million in funding to provide technical assistance to industry partners in the Permian Basin and the Gulf of Mexico region, respectively. As government officials and industry executives have become increasingly focused on efforts to reduce carbon emissions, carbon capture technologies have emerged as an [innovative and lucrative method](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0z7GOhCAQANCvwQ4jI4gWFNfY7bVXmkFGlwRlA7Pr7t9fcv19wcv7uS03jCme-zce5Pi95QVXji9aRqmMBL3oJjjfhUk15JSF3oLWU9_cHWzKhhX6kQwiTn7UXk8ayPfems2oJjroQHejMqozQ29br4wiP04WzWAHhUJ3FCLn0vKdmN5Yt_TJLyrtmo8muTvzo4r-S8AsYL6uq42EbS67gJlOKvtH1k9lOgTMKxafT7nig5-F5JNjihU55lPiGWTlXHCnprjwuGJKsQ5W6G4_MKY_jf_Jvxz8BgAA__8S0F5K) of achieving that goal.
## "1923" Expands Filming to San Antonio
The Paramount+ series "1923," a prequel to "Yellowstone," is expanding its filming locations after Austin and Lockhart to [include downtown San Antonio](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLuOpDAQAL_GZCC78QMCB5eQzaUXogY3Q0vGIGgNM39_2tWmm1eppPr3GB_ImcvzL24U5b3sI87CLxq72rga7GirFCedelNRNAHaANb2bbXGzti5836yjroUXEsWF6KEJuhEMKWKI2iwujPOaOfb0EzGGZq6PqDzwRtUVlNi2c9GVhJ647Xkz_6is5n3rcpxFTku1f5RMCgY7vtuts-FBYvshfcvSMFARegU5LJREQUDnsJzJgWD6aGtF84bl2d9Yal_xNr03llwoTnWozpjOm7OmS8flNXPDTl_9-WXHa8I_wMAAP__3U9jAQ). Production is scheduled to take place on Broadway and Travis Street in mid-September, transforming the area to represent the 1920s era. The show, starring [Harrison Ford and Helen Mirren](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LGOhCAQgOGnwU4DCAIFxTV2e-2VZpDZdRJEo3Pr7ttf7vrr_-RPvq_bdAMqVB-fsGLk132bYGZ64uRbZVttJtPkmGQOqsGonO6dNib0zRKV92lQSULwOQwp6BkdzjkpD9JlnxqKWmojvbJK2qF3XVJWYfLBgR3coEAYiZl4OzpekPEF5728tyce3bytTYkL836K_kPoUejxuq5ufZ9QofJWafuNhB6xMh4MVFesLPQIB9NcUOhRBd23dyor1UcL3ydTbVWwwVtrun3ZmyPm_aJS6BycMPKxApW_Nf8j8Yz6JwAA__-_gGEI), continues to tell the early story of the Dutton family. Additional filming is expected to take place [in Galveston](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0z7FurDAQQNGvsTtWnrGNoXDxGrp9bUo04AFGMngFFtn8fZT06a-udD6e45Mky7H-p51jfS9lpLnKzWPXgG_QjU6nOJnUg-YIAW1A53qrt8gEbK1LlAjIhMX7eWmBvcMQrElGS0SDznTgwfjWhscEHnjq-kC-DS2QcoaT1HI-6saV33Qt-avcfD7msusct1pfl7L_FA4Kh7rxLAfvtJUs80-icIAebXMxXeVosFkk73KsCgd9xvT6lJzlaoNyZt1J8u-2_qG8I34HAAD__1Q2U8o).

body:
FBI engaged in ‘major-league cover-up’ of Trump assassination attempt, Judicial Watch says
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-w/s5ud94864e4)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-w/s2j101593c8)**
| | Hi everyone,
Yesterday marks exactly one month since the assassination attempt on President Trump, and the TRUTH behind that day's events is slowly being revealed. We have all the news for you on [Rocky Mountain Voice](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-w/sbmb44580b3).
This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, August 15, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[FBI engaged in ‘major-league cover-up’ of Trump assassination attempt, Judicial Watch says](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-w/s8n380856a0)** [THE BLAZE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-w/s8mae1f97c0)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-w/s5pda125025)
The FBI and the Biden-Harris administration are engaged in a “major-league cover-up on the near-assassination of former President Trump,” Judicial Watch Inc. asserted Aug. 12.
The accusation came after the FBI denied Judicial Watch’s request for records on the July 13 Pennsylvania rally at which Donald J. Trump was shot by Thomas Matthew Crooks.
Judicial Watch filed a Freedom of Information Act request with the FBI on July 26, seeking documents, emails, presentations, and other data regarding the FBI’s coordination with the U.S. Secret Service in preparation for the July 13 rally in Butler, Pennsylvania, at which Trump was shot in the ear. The request covered the time period from June 15 to present.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-w/sdhdae9c252)**
|
---
**[Following anti-gun session, bipartisan 2nd Amendment Caucus is being formed by Reps. Armagost, Bottoms](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-w/s4jbc858d73)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-w/sfncd48b0bd)
* State Reps. Ryan Armagost and Scott Bottoms have established a bipartisan 2nd Amendment Caucus in the Colorado House to uphold gun rights while emphasizing firearm safety and education.
* The caucus was created in response to recent sessions featuring restrictive gun legislation, aiming to craft sensible policies that protect firearm ownership rights.
* During the 2024 legislative session, several gun-related bills were introduced, with about half becoming law, marking one of the state's most anti-gun legislative sessions.
* Moving forward, the caucus will focus on promoting education, safety, and access to firearms, striving to make Colorado a national example of how to balance gun access with safety.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-w/s7me3757a1c)**
|
---
**[In bid to claim 8th District, Speaker Mike Johnson to headline fundraiser for Gabe Evans in Loveland](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-w/sfg973efa77)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-w/scg797401b4)
* House Speaker Mike Johnson will headline a fundraiser in Loveland, Colorado, for GOP congressional candidate Gabe Evans, who is challenging Democratic U.S. Rep. Yadira Caraveo in the competitive 8th Congressional District.
* The fundraiser, featuring tickets ranging from $500 to $10,000, includes prominent hosts such as former U.S. Senator Cory Gardner and state Senator Barb Kirkmeyer.
* Financially, Evans trails Caraveo significantly, with over $1 million raised compared to Caraveo's $4.5 million. Both candidates are seeing substantial external spending and support from their respective parties.
* The event is part of a series of fundraisers for Evans, including another in Denver with more affordable ticket prices, as he seeks to gain ground in this tightly contested race.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-w/scr5f180b29)**
|
---
**[Colorado Springs City Council sends sales ban of recreational marijuana to voters](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-w/sah81bd89ef)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-w/s8g126e39a2)
* The Colorado Springs City Council voted 8 to 1 to propose a charter amendment banning recreational marijuana stores, which would override city ordinances.
* A citizen's group is also attempting to get an initiative on the ballot that would allow existing medical marijuana dispensaries to sell recreational marijuana, with revenue supporting public services.
* The city is currently verifying the citizen's group's petition, which is reportedly 8,800 signatures short of the necessary amount for inclusion on the ballot.
* Previously, Colorado Springs voters rejected a proposal to legalize recreational marijuana sales, while nearby municipalities like Palmer Lake and Cripple Creek approved it.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-w/sctbaca3f77)**
|
---
**[‘It’s not any of their business’: Aurora Council nullifies new state law banning guns in government buildings](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-w/sfue93babbe)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-w/sfpbbf666c7)
* Aurora City Council voted unanimously to opt out of a Colorado state law banning firearms in government buildings, asserting local control over their security policies.
* The decision was made without opposition during the council meeting, following discussions that emphasized the council's responsibility for safety and security measures in their own facilities.
* The law from which Aurora opted out prohibits firearms in sensitive spaces including polling locations, schools, and government buildings across the state.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-w/s9qa86427aa)**
|
---
**[In Colorado Springs, voters will have chance to weigh whether to renew 0.57% sales tax for roads](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-w/sfn483db7e6)** [FOX21 NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-w/sel7cab441a)
* On Tuesday, August 13, the Colorado Springs City Council decided to present the renewal of the 2C Road Improvement Program for voter approval in November.
* The 2C program, which is funded by a voter-approved sales tax, primarily supports the repair and enhancement of the city’s road infrastructure. Initially passed in November 2015 and subsequently renewed in 2019, its current mandate will expire in December 2025.
* The proposed ballot measure seeks to extend the existing 0.57% sales tax, equating to 5.7 cents per $10 spent, for another decade beginning in 2026. Since its inception in 2016, the 2C program has successfully doubled the number of roads rated in "good" condition and reduced complaints about potholes by over 34%, according to city reports.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-w/s6s69da89e8)
|
---
**[One of the country’s largest rodeos, at Denver’s National Western Stock Show, is run by a woman](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-w/s9oafb0d21c)** [CBS COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-w/scn451baf6d)
_Caroline Lukens was born a cowgirl._
_“I got this cute little quarter horse named Ranger and he was my first horse,” Lukens said._
_Now she’s running the one of the nation’s premier livestock, rodeo and horse shows at the National Western Stock Show in Denver. As the rodeo operations coordinator, Lukens is responsible for producing one of the largest rodeos in the country._
_“Sometimes there are advantages to being a woman in a male-dominated industry; and it’s becoming less and less male-dominant too,” Lukens said._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-w/s4p4b08e039)**
|

**[Video: Has a Venezuelan gang taken over an Aurora apartment complex?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-w/s3te062633b)** [FREE STATE COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-w/scifed0d662)
_Has an apartment management company in Aurora failed to maintain their property, as[one media outlet reported](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-w/sfn81cd4d30), or has the Venezuelan gang, Tren de Argua, taken over the property by force?_
_That’s the focus of an interview by[Free State Colorado’s Brandon Wark](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-w/sbq93bfc0f9) with Aurora City Councilwoman Danielle Jurinsky. In the video, Jurinsky shares her perspective on the truth of whether the property is owned by a slum lord, or whether it has been taken over by Tren de Argua, as [John Tiegen supports in this post](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-w/s9t43b994b5)._

We have all the news for you on . This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, August 15, 2024. – Heidi Ganahl | | | TODAY'S TOP STORIES The FBI and the Biden-Harris administration are engaged in a “major-league cover-up on the near-assassination of former President Trump,” Judicial Watch Inc. asserted Aug. 12. Ryan Armagost and Scott Bottoms have established a bipartisan 2nd Amendment Caucus in the Colorado House to uphold gun rights while emphasizing firearm safety and education. During the 2024 legislative session, several gun-related bills were introduced, with about half becoming law, marking one of the state's most anti-gun legislative sessions. Moving forward, the caucus will focus on promoting education, safety, and access to firearms, striving to make Colorado a national example of how to balance gun access with safety. | House Speaker Mike Johnson will headline a fundraiser in Loveland, Colorado, for GOP congressional candidate Gabe Evans, who is challenging Democratic U.S. Rep. In office, he’s signed historic legislation to expand voting rights, protect reproductive freedom, secure paid family and medical leave, and more. name: Crystal Cavalier via ActionNetwork.org
subject: Youth Learning at Gathering of the Voyagers
body:
Our next phase is to put it all together with our relatives from Maui. Taski: ta youth learn about water, rivers, ecosystems, and how to protect what we hold dear while learning what is important. | | | Me:Ku! Greetings.
I am writing to give a summer of youth update. How can we fight pipelines and corporations that destroy our communities if we don't involve our youth and help them understand? This summer has been busy for the team. Staff is handling new SSEP and old MVP Southgate pipelines, regional mining, environmental harms, and more. We are in the communities, door-knocking and holding information sessions. Staff is working with interns to assemble our Haw and Roanoke Rivers Watershed information page with plants, insects, animals, and wildlife. We have been holding cultural events, youth events, and more. [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38nwvmITjk7OAy8ee1vEau0x4wzyK8zSUXLvPrbLmy9i7uFDspX5gvU_R0nlENsoARLhKXY19Ibc29HsI-Q714AGVX8j50mEUJWBeZsZH5ljrMPBBQABn5dgF91CJk4KZZkA8nYj_YRRdV68Lc2nw_jorg_tzZrgV6BbE_RWgY2JvQUIxyeiGFo2qrWBvO099ciUlMu-3Iv0tci_Ykx7ohGA0jtExsPYNkkG_gUSENDZ6r_ETtQ7Qr2uYx8JtzHMF8w4h6ZRWGCwnlvdxfQlDHzLt8CIdT1SvQSToopjQBv8iNNGqmbCDABoyPAUvLrzZ4/48x/XFFuXDDuSpy_rX_-qY-SDw/h0/h001.HzcUICRcIV9fxxpKS3DqBVZfAfeWnN0cfLk2e4l-Q-M)In May 2024, we held a coming-of-age ceremony for four young women in our community. In June, a few young women attended the historic Yesah Tribunal to understand what the Rights of Nature mean and how they affect them. These young women have been documenting their summer with cameras and journaling their experiences. A few of the youth attended the 7 Directions USAswim program, and a few youths participated in the iSTEAM program, which helped us document what animals, birds, and insects live in our watersheds, which is an education component to help them prepare for the next part of this journey. [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38nwvmITjk7OAy8ee1vEau0x4wzyK8zSUXLvPrbLmy9i0e5z-rwI5lmLunOSRTptMhBPMd2-I_w11GN-kMQHKNh4uteCXciXbfbEBC_OeVwPuHB1-ckbcQMtPypUh2bNGnzycRJKZNDnKX_aarc3cZFMiOeOxxWTKUEyI1CG-sB5IytRc7kUrnuDX_7YONJ7hcxJWIl0pinzsIVnXKp6WidSlPNNHt7UW_l3ikI25ijq6SuIqRPA9Oe9T56nVHuA1Yn67kFtxHI2UErn33xikq9rGJiiDIjGC55YrBStebn8dfrFtM2rz_TESjIgAiaKHI/48x/XFFuXDDuSpy_rX_-qY-SDw/h1/h001.Jyt4JX-txiYanSk_4-gsFlbXBEIgHrF1BI8KoSCaEOk)
We're [raising funds](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38nwvmITjk7OAy8ee1vEau0x4wzyK8zSUXLvPrbLmy9i_Rq12yHEHT9yTq01B2IANZDZ3j0ArWS6Lt31aSUs_8JvgXfTc7z0yYKtCdr6-EKle3imFpx_p-vw6c40QVO7w0VgurTqK38GveFiOrKcAZCufygopxvNV6ML9vjkgsnDKVSRX5CDw_ZWpJJwyYs3KEXBOOpRiSFF9gc6vjr4toOPSUOJtWTCY23YoKrF4MTIUfgmM4HUomQU-c_1aw29wW1XJu3WVJsANI3B87EdHP-meRuV_6tdOaKaX-tPmuFfF2sOEew5_B83ASSkm0fs-c/48x/XFFuXDDuSpy_rX_-qY-SDw/h2/h001.EoXmdPiTtIVsgiL1b9I3HEqDjSOWE0F8QJiqKbGGGo4) to send our River Stewards youth to the Gathering of the Voyagers in Maui for a unique cultural exchange about water, rivers, and ecosystems. Every donation, no matter the size, [significantly](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38nwvmITjk7OAy8ee1vEau0x4wzyK8zSUXLvPrbLmy9i1aWyKbG3IAGuyX7ls26W3I6vC36uNErem8lMLv32Acr5pmZjkl81PTTEJk9_djuFKa1p7iiihJSTY8CVyZrNixZWwhwRIKwwTZ8txQFn1Z2KfaSfTfeTFi9dQQLEdKiIcZFgaQcqJhS6D2rMMXmFk8wPvEN4MC0nS4ntJRamPEAHDtobKH4Jc1XLc5OuY1tp3m_Rp8OkEe3ydYyriZFu9oeAXLHPIDPGWgQ7LYi2uPZ_h7rIk_R05kgd5pbKPrqrelrTE_bl-m_Wkb1f7tCX9E/48x/XFFuXDDuSpy_rX_-qY-SDw/h3/h001.78dTOJEBfCEf9uSLD1rh7MKYLXOfGJiAKKtScWyMKLM) impacts these kids' learning and growth, so please consider clicking the link to donate or share. Our River Stewards program is a journey of learning and growth. We've started with a USA swim grant and an ecological program at the Haw River. We're excited to take the next step by joining our relatives from Maui. This unique cultural exchange will teach our youth about water, rivers, ecosystems, and protecting our natural resources.
Annually, we attend the Gathering of the Voyagers in Kīhei, Maui, to immerse our students in cultural exchanges and the experience of learning from how Polynesian ocean voyages. We are reaching out to our community to help support our youth so they can attend the Gathering of the Voyagers (08/23-08/25), share their stories, and learn from ocean elders. Taski: ta youth learn about water, rivers, ecosystems, and how to protect what we hold dear while learning what is important. | | | Me:Ku! Greetings. I am writing to give a summer of youth update. How can we fight pipelines and corporations that destroy our communities if we don't involve our youth and help them understand? This summer has been busy for the team. Staff is handling new SSEP and old MVP Southgate pipelines, regional mining, environmental harms, and more. We are in the communities, door-knocking and holding information sessions. Staff is working with interns to assemble our Haw and Roanoke Rivers Watershed information page with plants, insects, animals, and wildlife. We have been holding cultural events, youth events, and more. May 2024, we held a coming-of-age ceremony for four young women in our community. In June, a few young women attended the historic Yesah Tribunal to understand what the Rights of Nature mean and how they affect them. These young women have been documenting their summer with cameras and journaling their experiences. A few of the youth attended the 7 Directions USAswim program, and a few youths participated in the iSTEAM program, which helped us document what animals, birds, and insects live in our watersheds, which is an education component to help them prepare for the next part of this journey. We're to send our River Stewards youth to the Gathering of the Voyagers in Maui for a unique cultural exchange about water, rivers, and ecosystems. Every donation, no matter the size, impacts these kids' learning and growth, so please consider clicking the link to donate or share. Our River Stewards program is a journey of learning and growth. We've started with a USA swim grant and an ecological program at the Haw River. We're excited to take the next step by joining our relatives from Maui. This unique cultural exchange will teach our youth about water, rivers, ecosystems, and protecting our natural resources. Annually, we attend the Gathering of the Voyagers in Kīhei, Maui, to immerse our students in cultural exchanges and the experience of learning from how Polynesian ocean voyages. We are reaching out to our community to help support our youth so they can attend the Gathering of the Voyagers (08/23-08/25), share their stories, and learn from ocean elders. We will present the voyagers, elders, and hosts with our roanoke and wampum shells when we arrive at the gathering. Your will enable us to bring three staff members, six youth, and two elders and their families from North Carolina to attend the Gathering of the Voyagers and support the next generation of youth. At the end of the fall, we invite you to celebrate our youth and have them present what they learned on their 2024 journey this summer (stay tuned). Thank you for considering our cause. Alvin Bragg doesn’t appear to think they did anything wrong. As a result, these hateful left-wing protesters will not see the inside of a courtroom.

Friend,
My career in public service began in 2016, when I was recruited to flip a competitive House seat blue. I was serving as the president of Nevada’s largest synagogue, and looking back now, that was incredibly fitting – **because my Jewish faith and values have always been at the very core of my work in Congress.**
In fact, my decision to run for public office was guided by the Jewish principle of Tikkun Olam _–_ _to leave the world a better place than how we found it._
I’m so proud of the progress we've made in the years since. And in the face of growing antisemitism, attacks on reproductive freedom, and threats to tear down our democracy, I'm as committed as ever to making positive change happen. **But** **I****need _your_ help.**
**Right now,****polling shows me locked in a statistical tie with Trump-endorsed candidate Sam Brown – who set a major GOP fundraising record in this race that will likely decide Senate control. So please, I'm humbly asking:**

This is probably the hardest email I’ve ever written.

| |
---
| | | | | | | | Friend \--
I wish things would have gone a different way... | **_Democrat Vicente Gonzalez holds back Republican surge, returns 34th Congressional District to Democratic control._**
---

This is probably the hardest email I've ever written.

**I 'm Mayra Flores, the America First Hispanic woman running in the biggest race in the nation.**

After we made history and flipped a blue seat red for the first time in 100 years, the Democrats threw the kitchen sink at me, **and I had to concede my race. **

[](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/OJsqG6ydt8vHdJdq-DIk9A~~/AARclAA~-ZrZ9TA9SFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)

---
Everyone expected me to just walk away - _but I 'm not someone who ever, ever gives up._

I'm taking a leap of faith here and have thrown my name on the ballot once again.

The Democrats overpowered us in this race before - _and now all indicators are pointing toward this election being a complete toss-up._

My stomach is in knots - **the Democrats have already raised an astonishing $30 MILLION, and Kamala Harris just raised $100 million bucks**(I know, I can't believe anyone would give her money either...but they do).

**That 's why I'm humbly asking for your help: _[Will you step up and chip in just a few bucks in the next hour to help us counter this massive Left-wing onslaught?](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/OJsqG6ydt8vHdJdq-DIk9A~~/AARclAA~-ZrZ9TA9SFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA "Will you step up and chip in just a few bucks in the next hour to help us counter this massive Left-wing onslaught?")_**

I'll just tell you: I'm afraid to see what happens if this email doesn't work.

**The Democrats & the media hacks are terrified of me - that's because as a young Hispanic female, I obliterate every woke narrative they push. So, they will truly do anything to destroy me.**

The Democrats know that if they lose the Hispanic vote, it's over for them. _Forever._

I'm opening my heart to you here: Please, please help out:

---
God bless you, and God bless America.

**Mayra Flores**
America First Candidate
Texas Congressional District 34

Help me speak louder
| Peter, I experienced the left’s radical gender ideology firsthand.
**When I was in college, I was forced to compete against a man at the NCAA Women’s Swimming Championships.** But instead of staying silent,**I spoke louder**. And I’m still speaking out, Peter. Men and women are different -- equal, but different. No matter how much the gender radicals demand otherwise. That’s why I’m fighting back, with the**Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute. ** Through the Riley Gaines Center, my team of Ambassadors and I spearhead a growing nationwide movement to defend women, common sense, and free speech. This isn’t just a women’s issue. _It’s a humanitarian issue_. It affects men and women, girls and boys. Because men don’t want to see women robbed of their opportunities or put in danger. And every person has the right to speak the truth. Will you help me speak louder and strengthen this movement? name: Jason Johnson
subject: Update: Campaign Suspension
body:
Dear Supporters,
It is with deep admiration and respect for the work we have accomplished together over the last year that I share with you the decision to suspend our efforts in seeking the congressional seat for Maryland U.S. District 6 for the 2024 election.

As you know, the state board of elections required our campaign to provide a minimum amount of signatures for ballot access. Regrettably, as of the state’s August 5th deadline we were shy of the required amount.

I stand fully assured that this perceived setback will serve as a redirection into a greater opportunity for service to our community.

Good work continues, but the work accomplished during this season was not on my own.

I thank God who is the source of my strength and service.

I thank my family for so graciously giving of themselves in support of this campaign.
My service is their service. To my lovely wife Jilcia, where would I be without you? To my darling children Ariel and Emmanuel, who would I be without you?

To my friends, volunteers and supporters thank you, thank you, thank you. This campaign was dedicated to empowering you.

Going forward, I can share that I will maintain a servant’s heart and will continue to reach out in the service of others. I encourage you to do so as well.

Yours in service,

Jason "Mr. J" Johnson

# [Demand Trump and Musk be investigated for violating labor law](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta80fee57-04b3-4427-9126-75525426a625/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8164595f-c0b6-4fd7-888f-e7e4d82e51de/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | | Donald Trump and Elon Musk had a bizarre, rambling, 2-hour interview livestreamed on X (Twitter). But in the midst of it all, it appears they opened themselves up to charges they violated labor laws against threatening workers who try to organize. As reported on [CNN](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8bdf8994-48da-4c8c-8692-1755c8cda455/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9): Trump called Musk “the cutter,” and praised Musk for his anti-union stances. “I look at what you do, you walk in and you just say, ‘You want to quit?’ They go on strike – I won’t mention the name of the company – but they go on strike, and you say, ‘That’s okay, you’re all gone. You’re all gone. Every one of you is gone,” Trump said. Musk could be heard laughing and replying “yeah.” The United Auto Workers union has responded by filing labor law charges against Trump and Musk for threatening workers who try to organize. This should be investigated immediately by the National Labor Relations Board, and Trump and Musk should both be held accountable if they’re found guilty. [Sign your name: Demand Donald Trump and Elon Musk be investigated for violating labor law >>](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta4dc24f1-2e82-49df-a567-44f9fe5b2b68/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| Peter, I wanted to reach out inform you of [Governor Youngkin's Executive Order 36](https://f1v3ff69.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fwww.governor.virginia.gov%2Fexecutive-actions%2F%23orders/1/01000191567cd6d7-a2c98f58-eacb-4f44-bb38-6f1c14755cd5-000000/2-K8gy4fXRAFkRn2WqT0gyz954o=387) that went into effect today. ** _Over 50% of Virginia 's currently incarcerated population have recidivated._** Yes, you read that right. Over HALF of the individuals currently housed in Virginia's correctional system are re-offenders. That's an egregious statistic that cannot go ignored. As Virginians, we've got simple needs: we want life to be easier, better, and most of all SAFER! Safer for our kids, our friends and family, our neighbors, our coworkers, and ourselves. **So how do we accomplish this goal?** Governor Youngkin has issued an extremely comprehensive executive order today to set us on the right path, establishing Virginia's '**Stand Tall** ' initiative. '**Stand Tall** ' has been in action since April 2023 as a proof of concept, but has been formalized today by executive order. Over the past year and a half, we've seen improved parole outcomes, and absconding rates have **_gone down for the first time in 12 years!_** This initiative makes use of pre-existing state resources and has been implimented at **_no additional cost_** to the Virginia taxpayer. For years, we've fought against Democrats trying to make parole easier to achieve for violent offenders. That's a shortsighted solution that accomplishes **_NOTHING_**. Instead, Governor Youngkin's administration has focused on a few key aspects of the re-entry process: -Gainful Employment-Proper Parole Supervision-Mental Health Treatment-Substance Abuse Treatment I'm proud to support Governor Youngkin in his initiative to clean up Virginia's streets and ensure that **_we aren 't releasing violent criminals_** back into society, and **_instead focusing on putting Virginians with minor offenses in a position to succeed as productive members of society_**. As always, please don't hesitate to reach out to my office should you have any questions. Yours in service,

#
Friend of Life,

My name is Lila Rose. I'm the founder and president of Live Action.

Today Live Action is the online, educational leader of the pro-life movement. We reach millions of Americans each month--changing minds and hearts and saving lives.

I wanted to alert you about a growing threat to preborn babies, one that is contributing to the growth in abortion numbers this year.

That's right. Even though _Roe v. Wade_ is gone, abortion rates are _growing_ instead of decreasing. Reports say that a preborn child in the United States now loses its life every 31 seconds.

And, corporate America has decided to jump on board and expand the killing.

**You see, at least 114 big corporations are paying --often pressuring--their female employees to fly to pro-abortion "sanctuary" states like California to kill their preborn children.**

Corporations like Amazon, Nike, Uber, Target, Disney, Starbucks, Sony, eBay, CVS, Apple, Bank of America, and 103 others are offering women $4,000, $5,000, $10,000, or unlimited "travel" and "lodging" to go abort their children.

It's beyond sickening.

Killing a baby is cheaper for businesses than maternity leave. Bosses can get the mother back to work faster. This is calculated evil, sugarcoated as "affirming" and "healthcare."

Corporate America should _help mothers_ embrace the lives of their children, not pressure them to have them killed!

**[Will you give $50 right now to help save at least one baby from this corporate greed?](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=af8ffdbd3fd0400ba5ca1c9b27dd90ce&_e=z07TxyGbkNJhrR2hAYqXNqWc8Vj9da-ft926hB-dwkPjmbYwpKsCaOex9vjyVuhi-yAwrsAxQq4hNIoIGI1VFtb0WyFIr4eY5omr_Al6f0i__Dpt4tdWVOA-WV1R5PtpfEA0l8dWWFk8Lt5nTHtNmWZCsWWr1VNibXv1MjMYHJvLmwnYfL2cKWzH06-o0pvtyU7dyKzej8Nxz60zaWjsyvWEMTroBfmgFHGcD91iTBU9d__ijOTAHu93fczzKHKkBIwuUrgBAv8Gb2Ko7DFD9jDsrlDsvK75BXmMoKkxF4Kry1U3MsOhqvvDc7SaHe_Py1DauuSCduQUAd8Ri9FSsp-NcJ6EBMR1JSZ499phCd0%3D)** You will also spare parents a lifetime of loss and regret.

Your gift will reach parents moments away from an abortion decision with the truth they need to embrace life.

We discovered that spreading TRUTH in compelling and persuasive online videos is the single best tool to reach and compel millions of Americans, especially abortion-minded parents, and prevent abortions. Our videos include:
* Eye-opening facts about the humanity of a baby in the womb
* Raw, horrific truths about the abortion procedures
* Shocking details about the ugly, corrupt abortion industry

These high-quality videos change minds and hearts. 43% of those who follow Live Action say our content changed their position from pro-abortion to pro-life!

Your donation will also reach parents with _Window to the Womb_ , a state-of-the-art, Hollywood-quality, 3-D animated video showing the development of "Baby Olivia" from fertilization to birth.

**Some pregnancy resource centers share that 75% of abortion-minded women who view ultrasounds reject abortion.** One single mother sent us this note after viewing _Window to the Womb_ depicting "Baby Olivia":

"_I can barely pay the bills on time. . . . I was considering abortion for my 5th child, but after watching, I came back into the light and realized it would be so wrong to deprive a child of this wonderful thing we call life. Her name will be Olivia, too._"

name: Tom Fitton
subject: A Quick But Very Important Update!
body:
Your time is valuable, so let me get right to the point... Judicial Watch is fighting on more fronts than ever to expose public corruption, support the rule of law and fight for the American people's "right to know"...

| | |
---
|
---
|
---
| Dear Fellow American,

Your time is valuable, so let me get right to the point...
**Judicial Watch is fighting on more fronts than ever to expose public corruption, support the rule of law and fight for the American people's "right to know"...**
**[And at this critical point in mid-August, I am asking for you to give us your support!](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69644&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)**
**Here's why:** | [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69644&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

* **We 're pursuing our next steps in preparation for litigation **over the U.S. Secret Service's denial of multiple Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) requests we have made related to last month's assassination attempt on former President Trump, which resulted in the death of an innocent bystander. The Secret Service is in full cover-up mode over its _epic failure_ to protect Trump and others at the rally...and we will use every legal tool to force the release of documents the American people have a right to see!

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69644&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---
* **Last week we filed a FOIA lawsuit against the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS)** for records of Anthony Fauci, other top officials, grantees and contractors regarding efforts to _subvert FOIA and other information requests about COVID issues_. We know that there was a systematic attempt by government bureaucrats to circumvent FOIA requests during the COVID era. We are committed to undoing this massive cover-up about government response to one of the biggest public health crises in recent years.

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69644&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---
* **We're anticipating a ruling _any day now_ on our motion for expedited appeal **in our lawsuit against **Mississippi** over its law that permits ballots to be counted up to 5 business days after Election Day. Our motion would open the door to possibly shutting down this open invitation to voter fraud before the November 5th general election. And we are also pursuing a similar lawsuit against **Illinois** and its 14-day law "extending" Election Day!

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69644&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

We have never been more deeply involved in consequential legal battles over transparency in government and preserving honest elections...

...and that is why I am _[counting on you to help now](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69644&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)_.

The American legal system is slow at times, but it works best at stripping away the efforts of corrupt politicians and secretive bureaucrats to keep "we the people" in the dark about what our government is doing....

...and the legal system and the courts are _just as critical_ in helping protect fair and honest elections from the Left's attempts to corrupt them!

Thanks to the support of our members, today Judicial Watch is the largest and most effective government watchdog group in the nation. We're always fighting for you and the rule of law!

Thank you in advance for helping us perform all this essential work.

Sincerely,

Thomas Fitton
President

subject: Justice finally served in NJ parental rights complaint!
body:
Peter, Minor children shouldn’t be asked intrusive survey questions about their family’s beliefs about politics, race, gender
|
---
| Peter, Minor children shouldn’t be asked intrusive survey questions about their family’s beliefs about politics, race, gender or sexual behaviors without parental knowledge and approval. Not appropriate. In fact, the “Protection of Pupil Rights Amendment” (aka – PPRA) is meant to protect parental rights around just this issue. A school district is bound by law to inform parents and give them the chance to opt their child out before performing one of these invasive surveys. Cedar Grove School District violated that law, and six parents filed suit back in 2021. Biden’s Department of Education was in charge of handling that complaint. No surprise – they sat on it until America First Legal intervened (read all about it [here](https://xtz223.keap-link002.com/v2/click/2a93b29bc8574ef01038b50cb933e30a/eJyNkcFuwjAQRP_FZ7YpSekhN4QQiqAcqvZcWfEmWXBsy95AU8S_d4GKUyv17DdvNN6TYnTacWVUqT75K88LNVERawqEjhfesa6vr_nsaVpMJ8qS26-iH4IqT7-G78AtVTxOFI8BBXl7nS_W1Xb1sam2ayGDjtLxP8_zLL97li_zaqPO5z_F2BMvD-JOquQ44GWRIVnF79EK3zGHVGaZbiy22j742GYHqtnHERpvrT-Sa0H3GKnW0FBMDFcSrD6mgRi4QxgggUEZwb1UgW8AzVBrJu-g13tM4oq9hBpy5iLkTjM4PMIOY8IRUt15b8FQYiliOJC3mtHA7WMkGantOGUySYeAzvzcY43jbdj5G51MmpM=)). On July 26th, they issued their findings and confirmed that Cedar Grove School District **violated the law.**

| It’s not often we get a win from the Biden Administration (actually more like never), but this one was just so obvious that they even had to reluctantly acknowledge the violation. WOW! Parents have a right to be in charge of their children’s education – _especially when it comes to sensitive topics_ like race, sexuality, and politics. If schools were more focused on academics and less on preparing the next generation of Leftist activists, we would be in a very different place as a state and a country. **But today, this win is worth celebrating.** Thank you to the incredible parents of Cedar Grove for standing up and fighting for all of us! And many thanks to the good people at America First Legal for fighting on behalf of these New Jersey parents and securing this rare victory for common sense and the plain reading of the law and the facts. Because sometimes these things just aren’t so common after all... If you want to be part of pushing back on the nonsense, the gaslighting, and the craziness going on around us on the daily, we’re your people. We’ll be here every day elevating the voice of New Jersey’s common sense majority and creating an environment where more wins like this are possible. In defiance and strength, Elizabeth Nader

Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=081524_1&amount=25]
Nothing is ever good enough for opponents of voting rights.
If the ballots are counted quickly and efficiently, reporting the results in a timely manner? " Oh it's rigged, no way they could have gone that fast ."
If precincts take their time counting the ballots and report everything at once? " Oh look how it all came in together, it's totally rigged ."
If the count takes a while, with precincts checking and reporting things all along the way? " Oh that took way too long, they were 'finding' more votes for themselves, that's completely rigged. "
These vote suppressors hold no logical position because they want you scared of voting and scared of our democracy. They think the only legitimate elections are the ones they win . And even then, opponents of voting rights will protest their own election race even if other races go the way they want for their party.

Our elections are closely monitored. Electronic vote counting is backed up by human tabulation. Nonpartisan election workers monitor everything, and in many states, partisan activists are there to question and verify results as well.
None of that matters to these all-or-nothing, brainwashed sycophants who only want a demagogue to tell them who to blame for their problems and their anger and accept these lies without using an ounce of brainpower to question them. Friend,
No matter what they say now, we know that Congressional Republicans are looking to enact a national abortion ban. A national ban has been their goal since Roe was decided more than 50 years ago, and they’re closer to achieving it than ever before after the Dobbs decision.
Republicans are looking to enact their draconian views on women’s rights onto the entire country, even though the country has consistently rejected their horrendous doctrine.
Let me be clear: reproductive healthcare is a right that should be enshrined in our constitution. Every woman in America should have the freedom to make her own healthcare decisions, especially decisions surrounding reproductive health.
With a national abortion ban now on the table, the stakes of the 2024 elections are even higher. The choice for voters is clear: Republicans plan to gut abortion rights nationwide if they take power. Democrats will fight to protect the rights of all women to make their own reproductive health care decisions.
Our opponent Chris Bentz sides with those who are attacking women’s rights instead of those who seek to defend them. He’s not fit to serve us in Congress. Will you donate $10, $25, $50, $100, or any other amount to help us defeat the GOP in 2024? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dan-ruby--friends-of-1?refcode=abortion1]

| [](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2uh332-elx4kr-kyd76rh0/)
---
| | | | A lot of folks probably don’t know this, folks, but Kamala Harris and I actually go way back. Both of us came up in public service as district attorneys, and over the last decade, we’ve fought hard to protect our communities and provide opportunities for all families. She’s been a mentor and friend for more than 14 years, and our relationship has helped shape how I view public service. I often refer to her as “ _my quintessential big sister_ ,” because she has always shown up for me when I needed her. In fact, when I first won my race to become Prince George’s County Executive, one of the first calls I received was from her. I’d like to share one piece of advice that she shared with me: _More important than being first at something is to make sure you are not the last._ And now that we’re standing on the precipice of electing our country’s first woman president, that advice feels more appropriate than ever. Once again, it seems we have a huge opportunity to elevate one another’s message and campaign, and deliver for those we seek to represent. Fellow Conservative - I have BAD news.

After MONTHS of endless attacks from Jon Tester, Chuck Schumer, and his dark money Super PACs, we knew our campaign had to set the record straight.

We put up television ads earlier than almost any other campaign because voters in Montana deserve to know the TRUTH regarding my record of service to our country.

name: Maxwell Frost
subject: Asking if you’ll support my friends at GIFFORDS PAC
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
When I was 16, my life was changed when I learned about the shooting at Sandy Hook Elementary School in Newtown, Connecticut.
#

[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-aug24.hBGz9O&refcode=em240815-1-BL&t=1&akid=8708%2E3935704%2E93iSrY)
---
Hi there -
My name is Maxwell Frost. I represent Florida’s 10th District in the US House of Representatives. I’m the first Gen-Z member of Congress, and I’ve been involved in the gun violence prevention movement for over a decade.
When I was 16, my life was changed when I learned about the shooting at Sandy Hook Elementary School in Newtown, Connecticut.
I was eating with my friends before a high school band concert when I saw the news. The tragedy called me to action, and I attended the vigil in Washington, D.C. where I met some of the loved ones of those who lost their lives.
I was eating with my friends before a high school band concert when I saw the news. The tragedy called me to action, and I attended the vigil in Washington, D.C. where I met some of the loved ones of those who lost their lives.
Seeing their pain, I knew that I could not rest until we see a future free from gun violence. And so I became an organizer in the gun safety movement. Then three years after Sandy Hook, I became a survivor myself.
I was appointed a vice chair of the Gun Violence Prevention Task Force in Congress—a position I’m honored to hold. We must enact transformative, commonsense legislation to end our country’s gun violence epidemic. That’s why I’ll work hard every day in Congress to make gun safety a reality in our nation.
I’m grateful that organizations like GIFFORDS will be there to help me with this important effort. GIFFORDS is one of the organizations leading the fight to keep our communities safe from gun violence. Like me, Gabby Giffords was inspired to dedicate her life to gun violence prevention a decade ago after the tragedy at Sandy Hook.
The team at GIFFORDS had my back during my election, and now I’m asking if you can step up today and support them before their important August mid-month fundraising drive comes to an end tonight.
[**Will you make a donation of any amount you can to GIFFORDS PAC? It all adds up to help fuel the work they do to help pass stronger gun laws and support candidates like me who will have the courage to act.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-aug24.hBGz9O&refcode=em240815-1-BL&t=2&akid=8708%2E3935704%2E93iSrY)

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

clean_body: Imagine the impact of another strong voice in the Senate, working alongside me to fight for our shared values. | Peter, Today, I am reaching out with an urgent call to action–one that will undoubtedly shift the balance of power in the Senate and give Republicans a fresh, strong voice in New Mexico. Of course, I’m talking about my friend Nella Domenici , a true fighter running for Senate in New Mexico. Nella represents the very best of our values and is committed to service and delivering results for the people of the Land of Enchantment. This election is not just about New Mexico – it’s also about securing a Republican majority in the Senate. Imagine the impact of another strong voice in the Senate, working alongside me to fight for our shared values. By electing Nella, we can ensure that we have the power to hold Democrats accountable for their reckless policies and out-of-touch agenda. The Left’s agenda has drained the pocketbooks of hardworking Americans and openly allowed MASS illegal immigration, crime, and drugs to pour across our southern border. Enough is enough. If you’re ready for change, Thank you for your urgent support, Senator Joni Ernst | ABOUT NELLA New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. # Erin Farris-Olsen for Clerk of the Montana Supreme Court 2024,

I am one of the only women on Montana’s statewide ballot in the 2024 election. I’m an attorney, a mother, a wife, an aunt and [**a candidate to be Montana’s next Clerk of the Montana Supreme Court.**](https://erinformontana.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=846aeb55e2fc599e968ca8fae&id=212a8370fd&e=5e62e9066d)
I may not have run for this honor if my opponent was not so extremely political and bad at his job. He openly brags about helping politically motivated attorneys get their way at the Montana Supreme Court.**We cannot tolerate political agendas influencing Montana’s highest court at any level.**

---
[](https://erinformontana.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=846aeb55e2fc599e968ca8fae&id=8f6407adb3&e=5e62e9066d)
| To win though, I need your help. **When women support women, we win - that’s why I am reaching out.**
I am facing a tough race, and the competition in this race only makes our circumstances more dire. I expect a very negative campaign, maligning my record as a public servant and an advocate for access to justice for all Montanans. The corporate lobbyists fueling my opponent's campaign have nothing but their own selfish interests at heart. And my opponent has bought into their agenda big time.
[**Help me win, and put an experienced, driven woman in office instead of a candidate who should never be anywhere close to the Clerk’s office.**](https://erinformontana.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=846aeb55e2fc599e968ca8fae&id=7bfe5b7c8c&e=5e62e9066d) We can only win if we work together, so work with me, and help me make our judicial system work better for all of us.
---
[SUPPORT TODAY!](https://erinformontana.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=846aeb55e2fc599e968ca8fae&id=410a497868&e=5e62e9066d)
| [**Please donate $50, $25 or $15 to help fuel my statewide grassroots campaign to take the Clerk of the Montana Supreme Court back from the political extremists and the lobbyists fueling his campaign.**](https://erinformontana.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=846aeb55e2fc599e968ca8fae&id=30df9014d6&e=5e62e9066d)
We can, and must, do better Montana!
Thank you, in advance, for your consideration, your support and your vote.
Regards,
**Erin**

The IRA is the largest investment ever made in climate and clean energy, and we thank the Biden-Harris administration for making this possible. **We want to take a moment to celebrate the tremendous programs and funding available to the public that the IRA has created for us. [Will you help us celebrate?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/90877683/491969850/-1943194573?contactdata=nXHodGaHRnFzQ0jWlWs93xg5BX2DeOv8eMnRPVZ/gMe+CmmDSUR84WzV5SNGv45QCQIm8i2l1qpcl5N8Wqfq3Wd/AyyUBosLX5JylaaYdt2Y+wy6/Ry9HstMIP866Qs5&quick=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImFkNjQwM2IwLTIxNWItZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGRiZmM0YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=2nDif0YIdljzZu2MPIo-W-X4giHQVh3_yHGYvVEBZ4k=&emci=0fed1a37-745a-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=ad6403b0-215b-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=2107230)** Let’s take a look at what these investments are doing across the country:
* Creating more than [312,900 good-paying clean energy jobs across 47 states](https://click.everyaction.com/k/90877684/491969851/-2027711229?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImFkNjQwM2IwLTIxNWItZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGRiZmM0YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=2nDif0YIdljzZu2MPIo-W-X4giHQVh3_yHGYvVEBZ4k=&emci=0fed1a37-745a-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=ad6403b0-215b-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=2107230) (including Oregon!)
* Clean energy industry is powering economic growth with [$500 billion in new investments and 100,000 new manufacturing jobs](https://click.everyaction.com/k/90877685/491969852/-829487481?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImFkNjQwM2IwLTIxNWItZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGRiZmM0YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=2nDif0YIdljzZu2MPIo-W-X4giHQVh3_yHGYvVEBZ4k=&emci=0fed1a37-745a-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=ad6403b0-215b-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=2107230)
* Saving families money with tax credits and rebates for energy efficient home upgrades and electric vehicles (EVs)

body:
Thousands of people lined up in cities across the country to learn about their new rights and protections. | | | Peter, Immigrant youth fought like hell to win DACA — a life-saving program that has opened doors to opportunities and offers temporary protection from deportation for some undocumented people. **And 12 years ago today, applications for DACA opened up, and _thousands_ of people lined up in cities across the country to learn about their new rights and protections. **The hope present in the streets was unlike anything before. Since that day, hundreds of thousands of immigrant youth have applied for and received DACA protections, which allowed them to go to school, work, and start families free from the threat of deportation. The DACA program was a _historic victory_ for immigrant youth who advocated tirelessly for this program. But since then, anti-immigrant Republicans have fought the program tooth-and-nail with every tool in their toolbox. They are _still_ spending big on court cases to strike down the program completely, even after Judge Hanen shut down the program to new applicants three years ago. In the 12 years since DACA has passed, UWDA has stood strong in the face of right-wing, white supremacist attacks on this key program. When Trump came for DACA, we fought back with the same tenacity that it took for immigrant youth and our allies to win DACA just over a decade ago. Looking back on the last 12 years of DACA, it remains a powerful reminder that we _can_ create real change. That when immigrant youth fight, we win. body:
Where we might differ a bit from others is that emails like this, alongside text messages, ads, and other donations that come through online... they make up the vast majority of the money we raise.
#

There’s no easy way to say this, Peter.
We’re falling far behind on our fundraising.
Every campaign is built around a series of fundraising goals. Ours is no different in that sense. Where we might differ a bit from others is that emails like this, alongside text messages, ads, and other donations that come through online... they make up the vast majority of the money we raise.
We set high goals this month, and we set spending commitments based on that projection. We did it because we had a really strong month in July, and we keep hearing about momentum and enthusiasm — we even saw it ourselves at the massive rally in Phoenix last Friday.
But all that momentum, all that enthusiasm... it just hasn’t translated into fundraising for our campaign.
Now, the way we see it, we’ve got two options ahead of our mid-month deadline tonight. Either our supporters pull through and get us to our goal, or we have to start looking at painful cuts. At this point in the race, we don’t have much room to fall behind — they make it all the more likely that Trump and Lake get the edge on us.
We can’t spend what we don’t raise, so we’re really hoping you can help.

Below is the full press release we put out yesterday regarding our full thoughts on the primary. Here are the high points and other observations:
* Voter Turnout was Low and Those that came out knew the candidate they were voting for
* We had exceptional turnout (all things considering) in Greenwich and Stamford which gave us a commanding lead
* We met a lot of voters at the poll and they knew who I was and had been reading these messages
* The big issues we heard were the issues we have been talking about for months and will continue to do so:
* Absurd Energy Prices and disgust for Eversource and UI
* Housing is not affordable in our district
* Healthcare is unaffordable and at a real crisis with the cost of prescription drugs
* Unaffordable Groceries and cost of living
* Need for Cheap Gas and Energy
* Closing the Border
* Anti-Semitism and the Anti-Americanism
* Fentanyl Deaths
* Republicans picked the People's Choice Candidates and demonstrated that We The People Matter - You made your voices heard.
* Every endorsement and letter of support was meaningful to different groups of voters
* Our Efforts were rewarded at the polls - we were responding to emails and texts until 4am on election day and returning phone calls from the polls and those interactions made the difference as it drove voters to the polls. As I said in my messages - "**If we are working this hard to earn your vote at the primary, imagine what we will do to work to defeat Jim Himes "**

Now the real work begins. We need you to start sharing this [substack ](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/1b1dd2d4-4d31-46bd-a808-8e00c2bc7fa9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)to all Connecticut voters, especially the unaffiliated, independents and libertarians that think like we do as this is a general election and the issues facing Connecticut are pocketbook issues.
If you are looking to help and volunteer and contribute we need all the help.
Thanks for your continued support - We live to fight another day and we are out there training for November - **Come Join Us**

Our Press Release
Dr. Michael Goldstein Excited To Take On Jim Himes In November After Winning Republican Primary In CT-04
GREENWICH, CT
Yesterday's victory at the polls was one for the people. In politics, there are parties and there are people. Yesterday was a demonstration that people matter and We The People matter. I'm in this race to heal Connecticut and take back our country. I'm also in it to Put a Doctor in the House to solve this country's healthcare crisis, along with so many other issues that affect everyone.
We expected low turnout considering the timing, but turnout was even lower than we expected. If you're ever asking yourself, does your vote count? I'm here to tell everyone that every vote matters and it really mattered to us yesterday.
I was the underdog. This was as they say a Rocky story for the ages. This journey began two years ago when I lost as an unknown candidate, and I have been fighting for the people ever since.
I want to thank my opponent, Bob MacGuffie, as this was a primary that tested everything. He was a worthy adversary, and we took these 12 rounds to the scorecard. We both fought fair, knowing that regardless of the outcome we would work collaboratively to take on Mr. Himes and pledged to do so. This election is about defeating a career politician and ensuring that our government lives up to its constitutional function as a government by the people and for the people.
I want to thank everyone who came out and volunteered and especially want to thank my hometown of Greenwich where we picked up 80% of the votes. The town rallied behind me from First Selectman Fred Camillo and Selectwoman Lauren Rabin, Senator Ryan Fazio, the Greenwich Republican leadership and to all of those who made the calls, worked the polls, wrote letters, sent emails and did not let the dog days of summer serve as an excuse.
A special thanks goes out to the 151st district where we kicked off this campaign and to State Rep candidate Tod Laudonia and his campaign team of Joe Montanaro and Gail Lauridsen who crushed the district and helped garner enough votes to give us a buffer. Rich and Kristy Niemynski did some yeoman's work as well in Greenwich and throughout the district. We also had help from Tina Courpas, a State Rep candidate in the 149th who helped in Greenwich and North Stamford.
I also want to thank Oxford First Selectman George Temple and Selectmen Arnie Jensen. Our politicking at the recycling center and their endorsement led to a commanding lead in Oxford. Mayor Lauretti in Shelton and his endorsement also gave us the lead in Shelton. Tom O'Dea, and the Stamford Republicans and State Rep candidates Olga Anastos, James Malerba and Rudy Settimi helped us take Stamford and New Canaan. State Senator Harding was also instrumental as well. We had some exceptional ground fighters with Cathy Walsh and Anne Manusky that helped us also with battleground towns of Oxford, Shelton and Easton that put us over the edge.
There are so many others I want to thank and all of those who believed in us and put their neck on the line to endorse a challenger candidate. I will be reaching out to everyone that helped as everyone made the difference. The list of endorsements I earned is extensive and every one of them helped in different ways. We had support from outside of Connecticut from the Medical Society of the State of New York and the New York Young Republican Club and national groups of Latinos United for Conservative Action. We also had the support of Connecticut's Law Enforcement with the Fraternal Order of Police.
I want to thank my supportive family, my wife Belle, my sons Stephen and Jonathan for being there and encouraging me to fight. My son and campaign manager, Jonathan, deserves special thanks for doing the work behind the scenes to develop and deploy a strategy that helped me win yesterday. He made some last-minute adjustments on our focus to get out the vote which paid off and he worked the polls till close picking up every vote he could. Dr. Joseph Bentivegna was instrumental in working on the campaign, especially with getting the message out. He and Jonathan were instrumental in getting our message delivered to more than 30,000 people.
We look forward to working with Matt Corey and congratulate him on his primary victory. We also want to express gratitude to Gerry Smith and his team as we campaigned with both candidates over the past few months and have a camaraderie outside of campaigning. We had a good time with this father son duo of Gerry and Ben Smith with the father and son duo of me and my son Jonathan.
Now the work begins, and we will be taking it to the streets and the people even more now that we are in a general election. Our republican base turned out, but this is all about getting to everyone as it's about the better message and the better solutions which we know we have.
I thank everyone for their continued support in time, energy and resources.
Dr. Michael Goldstein
Republican Candidate for US Congress CT-04

Thanks for your continued support - We live to fight another day and we are out there training for November - Come Join Us Contact us: Paid for by Goldstein for Congress Our Press Release Dr. Michael Goldstein Excited To Take On Jim Himes In November After Winning Republican Primary In CT-04 GREENWICH, CT Yesterday's victory at the polls was one for the people. In politics, there are parties and there are people. Yesterday was a demonstration that people matter and We The People matter. I'm in this race to heal Connecticut and take back our country. I'm also in it to Put a Doctor in the House to solve this country's healthcare crisis, along with so many other issues that affect everyone. We expected low turnout considering the timing, but turnout was even lower than we expected. If you're ever asking yourself, does your vote count? I'm here to tell everyone that every vote matters and it really mattered to us yesterday. I was the underdog. This was as they say a Rocky story for the ages. This journey began two years ago when I lost as an unknown candidate, and I have been fighting for the people ever since. I want to thank my opponent, Bob MacGuffie, as this was a primary that tested everything. He was a worthy adversary, and we took these 12 rounds to the scorecard. We both fought fair, knowing that regardless of the outcome we would work collaboratively to take on Mr. Himes and pledged to do so. This election is about defeating a career politician and ensuring that our government lives up to its constitutional function as a government by the people and for the people. I want to thank everyone who came out and volunteered and especially want to thank my hometown of Greenwich where we picked up 80% of the votes. The town rallied behind me from First Selectman Fred Camillo and Selectwoman Lauren Rabin, Senator Ryan Fazio, the Greenwich Republican leadership and to all of those who made the calls, worked the polls, wrote letters, sent emails and did not let the dog days of summer serve as an excuse. A special thanks goes out to the 151st district where we kicked off this campaign and to State Rep candidate Tod Laudonia and his campaign team of Joe Montanaro and Gail Lauridsen who crushed the district and helped garner enough votes to give us a buffer. Rich and Kristy Niemynski did some yeoman's work as well in Greenwich and throughout the district. We also had help from Tina Courpas, a State Rep candidate in the 149th who helped in Greenwich and North Stamford. I also want to thank Oxford First Selectman George Temple and Selectmen Arnie Jensen. Our politicking at the recycling center and their endorsement led to a commanding lead in Oxford. Mayor Lauretti in Shelton and his endorsement also gave us the lead in Shelton. Tom O'Dea, and the Stamford Republicans and State Rep candidates Olga Anastos, James Malerba and Rudy Settimi helped us take Stamford and New Canaan. State Senator Harding was also instrumental as well. We had some exceptional ground fighters with Cathy Walsh and Anne Manusky that helped us also with battleground towns of Oxford, Shelton and Easton that put us over the edge. There are so many others I want to thank and all of those who believed in us and put their neck on the line to endorse a challenger candidate. I will be reaching out to everyone that helped as everyone made the difference. The list of endorsements I earned is extensive and every one of them helped in different ways. We had support from outside of Connecticut from the Medical Society of the State of New York and the New York Young Republican Club and national groups of Latinos United for Conservative Action. We also had the support of Connecticut's Law Enforcement with the Fraternal Order of Police. I want to thank my supportive family, my wife Belle, my sons Stephen and Jonathan for being there and encouraging me to fight. My son and campaign manager, Jonathan, deserves special thanks for doing the work behind the scenes to develop and deploy a strategy that helped me win yesterday. He made some last-minute adjustments on our focus to get out the vote which paid off and he worked the polls till close picking up every vote he could. Dr. Joseph Bentivegna was instrumental in working on the campaign, especially with getting the message out. He and Jonathan were instrumental in getting our message delivered to more than 30,000 people. We look forward to working with Matt Corey and congratulate him on his primary victory. We also want to express gratitude to Gerry Smith and his team as we campaigned with both candidates over the past few months and have a camaraderie outside of campaigning. We had a good time with this father son duo of Gerry and Ben Smith with the father and son duo of me and my son Jonathan. Now the work begins, and we will be taking it to the streets and the people even more now that we are in a general election. Our republican base turned out, but this is all about getting to everyone as it's about the better message and the better solutions which we know we have. I thank everyone for their continued support in time, energy and resources. | Peter, this is the document that granted my great-great-great grandfather the right to vote in 1867. The significance of this is not lost on me – 146 years later, I’m running to become the first woman and person of color to represent Delaware in the Senate. [I can’t make history without your help. Will you rush $10 or more to send another Black woman to the Senate, keep Delaware blue, and defend our Democratic Senate majority?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T634f140e-0d19-4846-b6b4-747cc74061e3/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7dbae95d-e1ab-495b-851d-4430499f2611/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) I carry the story of my ancestors with me every day. It means so much to me that my sister Thea made it into a scarf. The day I was sworn-in, I carried that scarf. It was surreal – knowing how far my family, and so many families of color, had come. All the way from being enslaved, to finally getting the right to vote, to being elected to represent the First State. I also carried that scarf on the day of the January 6th insurrection. On such a dark day for our democracy, my scarf served as a reminder that every effort to undermine our democracy has been met with voices of power and reason. And I intend to carry that scarf when I’m sworn in to the Senate. [If you’re ready to join our movement, will you please chip in $10 to my Senate campaign? Every donation goes towards creating a more diverse and inclusive Congress and I sincerely hope you’ll get on board.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td3098d87-ef72-45f7-a011-698d11f4c4cb/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. **And savvy grassroots activists like you know, just like we do, that we can’t stop watching the people we help elect:_ after the elections, we have to keep organizing support for the policies we like and pushing back against the ones we don’t._** **__When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families.__** **Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we.** So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. name: Chuck Morse
subject: We Need Your Help This Weekend!
body:
| | | |
---
|
---

**Hey it's Brooks!**
**I know that many of your are still enjoying the summer months but we need your support this weekend. Team Morse will be marching in the _Londonderry Old Home Day Parade_ on _August 17th_ and we would love to see you there!**
**This is a great way to volunteer a few hours of your time to make a big difference in this campaign. This is an important event and we need to show New Hampshire the momentum that our campaign has built over the past year.**
**Please join us in marching with the next governor of New Hampshire!**
**_When:_ Saturday, August 17th ** **_Time:_ 9:00 AM line up, 10:15 AM parade kickoff** **_Where:_ Londonderry Middle School (313 Mammoth Road, Londonderry NH)** **_Contact:_ 901.409.4095**
**Parking:** Parking will be extremely limited, so carpooling is encouraged. Folks may be dropped off in the front parking lot of Londonderry Middle School, and there will be limited parking behind the school. The earlier you plan to arrive, the more likely you will secure a parking spot. The parade will end at Mack’s Apples, so if you can leave a car there, and carpool to the school, it’ll make transportation easier.
**Pre-Parade Organization:** Line up will begin at the Londonderry Middle School at 8:30AM. Volunteers must be on site by 9:00AM for lineup. Our ‘Chuck Morse for Governor’ float is slot number 5. We are behind the Londonderry Republicans, and before the Londonderry for Trump floats.
**Parade:** The parade will kick off at 10:15AM and ends at Mack’s Apples. It is a little over a mile walk, so please wear comfortable shoes. Folks who can’t walk the route may stand in the float, just please note that in the comment section of the RSVP form.
**Attire:** If you already have a Chuck Morse T-shirt please wear it! We may have a few more for volunteers, but we have very limited sizes. If not, please wear red/white/blue and any USA type attire - MAGA hats are welcome! Please be sure to also wear sneakers or another comfortable walking shoe.
**RSVP:** **If you haven’t already, please RSVP yourself and any additional volunteers through the following link so that we may ensure a proper head count:[_https://forms.chuckmorsefornh.com/landing/londonderry-old-home-day_](https://link.email.chuckmorsefornh.)**
