Peter,
Trump has a new and bizarre explanation for why Kamala Harris’ rally crowd sizes are bigger than his – **the photos and videos are all doctored and the crowds are AI generated.**
This obviously isn’t true. The validity of the photos and videos of her rallies has been verified by the _Associated Press_ , _Snopes_ , and even rally attendees. **So why are Trump’s claims going viral on TikTok?**
[**We’ll explain in a moment, but if you’re ready to help COURIER cut through the noise of right-wing misinformation on social media, can you chip in $20 now?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90882306/491983823/-593472309?refcode=20240815-EM-CrowdConspiracy&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiODdiZTM4MGMtMjg1Yi1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=xZmqADAGIzTqtzeluFzSRQtJsvUYYqKd6l8NLL_9i4Y=)
It’s no secret that misinformation and extremism thrive on social media. But thanks to TikTok’s secretive and highly personalized algorithm, its users are exposed to increasingly alarming false attacks on Vice President Harris.
**One video promoting the AI crowd conspiracy received over 3 million views. Another, 1.3 million. A third? Nearly 12 million views before TikTok eventually removed it. **
When Harris first joined the race, Trump, the far-right, and TikTok merged to spread racist and misogynistic attacks questioning everything from her qualifications to her intelligence.
**While the crowd size conspiracy seems trivial in comparison, it’s just as sinister.**
By asking supporters to question what they see with their own eyes, Trump is priming his base to question the election results in November if he loses. It’s a next level authoritarian move that would make Orwell blush.
**And TikTok’s algorithm rewards users for creating content that repeats a viral trend. That makes the platform the perfect vehicle for Trump’s conspiracy theories to spread at lightning speed.**

clean_body: A bizarre theory about Kamala Harris’ rally crowd size is spreading on the social media platform Peter, Trump has a new and bizarre explanation for why Kamala Harris’ rally crowd sizes are bigger than his – the photos and videos are all doctored and the crowds are AI generated. This obviously isn’t true. The validity of the photos and videos of her rallies has been verified by the Associated Press , Snopes , and even rally attendees. So why are Trump’s claims going viral on TikTok? = It’s no secret that misinformation and extremism thrive on social media. But thanks to TikTok’s secretive and highly personalized algorithm, its users are exposed to increasingly alarming false attacks on Vice President Harris. One video promoting the AI crowd conspiracy received over 3 million views. Another, 1.3 million. A third? Nearly 12 million views before TikTok eventually removed it. When Harris first joined the race, Trump, the far-right, and TikTok merged to spread racist and misogynistic attacks questioning everything from her qualifications to her intelligence. While the crowd size conspiracy seems trivial in comparison, it’s just as sinister. By asking supporters to question what they see with their own eyes, Trump is priming his base to question the election results in November if he loses. It’s a next level authoritarian move that would make Orwell blush. And TikTok’s algorithm rewards users for creating content that repeats a viral trend. That makes the platform the perfect vehicle for Trump’s conspiracy theories to spread at lightning speed. Here at COURIER, we have the tools to fight back against a social media misinformation campaign like this one. [](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ny_court_ruling_8_15_24_unnd1&n=4)

Dear Peter,
People have been asking about the New York case to remove me from the ballot, so let me tell you what it means.
[I’ll still be on the ballot, don’t worry about that. We will appeal this decision and win. ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ny_court_ruling_8_15_24_unnd1&n=5)
The worry here isn’t about my campaign for President. The worry is about the state of our country. **Basically what this case says is, “We don’t want you to choose.”**
Our campaign took on the 45,000 ballot signature requirement in New York and blew it out of the water. We collected over 135,000 signatures – more than any candidate in history.
But instead of bending to the will of the people, the DNC went behind their back to invalidate their choice.
Did you know that Iran and China have elections? Even the Soviet Union had them. **But you could only vote for state-approved candidates._Well, it’s turning into that here too_.**
As a result, the top 1% now owns more wealth than the 60% in the middle, our entire middle class. And hard working Americans can no longer afford life in America.
We have Kamala Harris – the hand-picked candidate of DNC insiders – now their presidential nominee without having received a single vote. But I’m not an approved candidate, so they’re trying to remove me from the ballot.
[The Democratic Party is trying to silence your voice and restrict your choice in our democracy. ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ny_court_ruling_8_15_24_unnd1&n=6)
[They are weaponizing the courts to take away your right to vote for the candidate you like best and choose the kind of America you want to live in. ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ny_court_ruling_8_15_24_unnd1&n=7)
**They don’t believe in democracy or trust the voters anymore.** They think they are entitled to choose who you are allowed to vote for. They think they should be the judge of what is best for you and your family.
That says something about the DNC’s contempt for democracy. Instead of fighting for voters’ rights, the DNC has a multi-million dollar army of lawyers devoted to reducing your choices at the ballot box.
**Are you going to stand by and let that happen?**
---
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ny_court_ruling_8_15_24_unnd1&n=8)
---
[The Democratic Party has become the biggest threat to democracy in this country. ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ny_court_ruling_8_15_24_unnd1&n=9)
The party that once stood for working people has abandoned them to Wall Street, Big Pharma, Big Tech, and the endless war machine.
I have a theory about what is behind the Democrats' transformation. **_It's fear_.**
**Democracy terrifies them because they are corrupt.** It terrifies them because they are addicted to power. It terrifies them because they are obsessed with control.
They want to control what we read on the internet. They want to control our medical decisions. And they want to control who we are allowed to vote for.
We have a perfect record of defeating DNC challenges. A court of appeals will reverse this decision, but the usurping of democracy won’t be reversed unless YOU reverse it, because democracy means rule of the people, and YOU are the people.
I will do my part too. My part is to make sure that you have the choice that the establishment wants to take away from you. **But I can't do it alone.**
[I need your support now to win this fight and get elected.](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ny_court_ruling_8_15_24_unnd1&n=10) Donate today to help us take on the establishment and secure victory in November.
| [](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em?amount=50&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ny_court_ruling_8_15_24_unnd1&n=11)
---

---
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em?amount=240&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ny_court_ruling_8_15_24_unnd1&n=14)
---

---
**I promise you, I will never bend to the bullying. I will fight for our country every step of the way to November 5th.**
And you will have an authentic choice of a truly independent candidate on Election Day.

Sincerely,
Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.

**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Hey Peter, it’s Joe.
I am incredibly proud to have been endorsed by California Senator Alex Padilla. Senator Padilla joins a long list of California leaders who are proud to be on Team Kerr, including Governor Gavin Newsom, and Congressmembers Adam Schiff and Katie Porter.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftjoekerr?refcode=x_081524_PadillaEndorsement [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftjoekerr?refcode=x_081524_PadillaEndorsement]
Their support means the world, but our campaign won’t get far without the support of everyday voters like yourself.
So, will you consider chipping in $10, $15, or $20 right now to help fuel my campaign to victory? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftjoekerr?refcode=x_081524_PadillaEndorsement]
Times are tough, but I assure you, the very moment I get sworn in, I'll get straight to work and continue my fight for the working families of CA-40!
And my resume will back me up – I am the only former Union Leader running for a seat in Congress. As a labor leader, I fought hard for my firefighters, and I'll fight like hell for all Americans.
You have my word.
I helped get over 200 bills and initiatives passed and signed into law, working with five different governors and two presidents. These bills and initiatives offered solutions to public safety, climate change, and policies to help working people.
I saved OC taxpayers hundreds of millions in Vehicle License Fee tax refunds and created a first responder healthcare system without raising a penny in taxes. For more than 30 years, I kicked down doors and saved lives in CA-40.
The best predictor of someone’s future actions is their past, and my opponent’s track record speaks volumes:
Young Kim voted against lowering gas prices (the Consumer Fuel Price Gouging Prevention Act ), and she voted against a Bipartisan border security bill.
When Americans call for help, Young Kim lets the line ring. She isn’t here for you.
I’ve had a lot of experience answering calls – in the middle of the night, in crises, etc.
Let’s give Young Kim the boot and really get to work. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftjoekerr?refcode=x_081524_PadillaEndorsement]

Joe Kerr

As the son of Cuban refugees, I know firsthand what **communists do when they get into power.**

They steal from the people, enrich themselves, and **end fair elections, so you can never vote them out.**

_**RIGHT NOW:**_ The Biden-Harris administration is preparing to contest a major election integrity bill in court if it passes.

# Democrats Deliver in the Senate, Help Defend in 2024
---
| [](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2uh6jj-em05ja-kyd76rh6/)
---
**Four Battleground States: Ohio, Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Montana.** Defending the Senate is crucial for making real progress on key issues such as abortion, climate change, and Social Security. The leadership of dedicated Democrats like Sherrod Brown in Ohio, Bob Casey in Pennsylvania, Tammy Baldwin in Wisconsin, and Jon Tester in Montana is essential to advancing policies that benefit all Americans. **Abortion Rights** : With ongoing threats to reproductive rights, it is more important than ever to have senators who will fight to protect a woman’s right to choose. Democratic senators have consistently stood up against efforts to roll back these rights and will continue to do so if we maintain control of the Senate. **Climate Change** : Addressing the climate crisis requires bold action and committed leadership. Senators like Tammy Baldwin, who serves on the climate change committee, have been at the forefront of promoting sustainable policies that protect our environment and create green jobs. Keeping these leaders in the Senate ensures continued progress on this critical issue that affects every state, industry, and citizen. **Social Security** : Protecting Social Security is vital for the well-being of millions of Americans. Democratic senators have been champions of preserving and strengthening this crucial safety net. Leaders like Sherrod Brown have introduced legislation to ensure the longevity and reliability of Social Security for future generations. These senators have shown unwavering commitment to these and other important issues, and now we need to have their backs going into one of the most contentious elections in recent history. Sherrod Brown, Bob Casey, Tammy Baldwin, and Jon Tester have proven their dedication to fighting for the rights and well-being of their constituents. Their leadership is essential for bringing our nation to a better place. [**You can make a real difference today by contributing to ALL FOUR battleground states with one donation. It is crucial that each of these Dems maintain their seats for at least another term, and we would love to give you the opportunity to contribute to these efforts.**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2uh6jj-em05jb-kyd76rh7/)

name: Tamie Wilson
subject: Fighting back against the Supreme Court’s attack on victims’ rights
body:
https://www.tamiewilson.com/ [https://www.tamiewilson.com/]
Friends,
When the Supreme Court handed down its 6-3 decision in the Cummings case last fall, it didn’t make splashy headlines like some rulings do.
But make no mistake: it’s had a devastating impact on victims of discrimination and abuse across the country.
This ruling set a dangerous precedent by determining that people who face discrimination – whether under the ADA, Civil Rights Act, Title VI, or Title IX – can only seek contract damages, not emotional damages.
In other words, TRUMP’S Su preme Court decided that the emotional and psychological suffering caused by discrimination and abuse doesn’t warrant compensation.
This decision is a slap in the face to victims who have already suffered so much.
It denies them the justice they deserve and makes it even harder for them to hold their abusers and institutions accountable.
Now, many cases are being dismissed because of this precedent, leaving victims with no recourse for the pain and trauma they’ve endured.
This is why I’m running for office – to fight for the rights and dignity of every person who has been wronged. I refuse to accept a system that turns its back on victims and shields those in power from accountability. We need leaders who stand up against these injustices and work tirelessly to protect the most vulnerable. If you believe in this fight, contribute to our campaign today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240815_ohio_state_update_link1]
This injustice is what I mean when I talk about the dangers of systemic abuse and the ULTRA-MAGA agenda and the courts they control.
I will not, WE CANNOT, let this continue. If we don’t stop them now, when will it end? It’s not just about the bombastic rhetoric; it’s about the quiet, insidious ways they set out to harm people and get away with it.
And make no mistake – Jim Jordan is a part of this.
As someone who turned a blind eye to the abuse happening under his watch at Ohio State, he’s now supporting a system that continues to betray victims.
I'm currently working with a bipartisan group of lawmakers in Washington to introduce and pass my bill, The Comprehensive Sexual Abuse Prevention and Accountability Act .
This legislation is designed to protect students and athletes from the kind of abuse we've seen ignored for too long. It ensures victims have the legal avenues to seek justice and hold their abusers accountable, even when institutions and politicians fail them.
That is what real leadership looks like.
If Donald Trump’s Supreme Court infuriates you as much as it does me, know that WE HAVE THE POWER to fight back.
I’m running for Congress to put an end to this kind of injustice. It’s time to show Jim Jordan the door because we know he won’t do anything, and I can’t stand by while victims suffer in silence.
If you believe in justice and accountability, join our fight to defeat Jordan. Dig deep and give big today. We have to spread our message across the district. Together, we can take down the ULTRA-MAGA agenda and build a future where every person’s rights are protected. Let’s send a message that enough is enough. Peter,

Arguments concluded in a key voting rights trial in Mississippi today. You may remember us reaching out to share that Ty is a plaintiff in this case and lent his testimony recently.

Ty joined the ACLU and Southern Poverty Law Center in bringing this case forward to address racial inequities in Mississippi’s Supreme Court districts. Those inequities have meant that _the Mississippi Supreme Court has only seen four Black justices and never more than one at a time._ That fact is a feature, not an error, in our current system – and Ty is fighting to right that wrong.

While we (not so) patiently wait for the court’s decision in this case, Ty’s not stopping his work. This issue goes beyond Mississippi, and ensuring fair access to the ballot for every American is a key tenet of Ty’s campaign for the U.S. Senate.

Restrictive voting laws make it difficult for voters to get accurate information and know when and how to cast their ballot. Our team is on the ground providing details on registering for the election and how to find their polling place – but we need your help to keep our work going strong.

clean_body: Arguments concluded in a pivotal case today = Peter, Arguments concluded in a key voting rights trial in Mississippi today. You may remember us reaching out to share that Ty is a plaintiff in this case and lent his testimony recently. Ty joined the ACLU and Southern Poverty Law Center in bringing this case forward to address racial inequities in Mississippi’s Supreme Court districts. Those inequities have meant that the Mississippi Supreme Court has only seen four Black justices and never more than one at a time. That fact is a feature, not an error, in our current system – and Ty is fighting to right that wrong. While we (not so) patiently wait for the court’s decision in this case, Ty’s not stopping his work. This issue goes beyond Mississippi, and ensuring fair access to the ballot for every American is a key tenet of Ty’s campaign for the U.S. Senate. Restrictive voting laws make it difficult for voters to get accurate information and know when and how to cast their ballot. Our team is on the ground providing details on registering for the election and how to find their polling place – but we need your help to keep our work going strong. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately. | = = = = = Your support is making a true difference in Mississippi. | | **For Immediate Release:** August 15, 2024
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**VIDEO: MIN RELEASE FIRST AD OF THE GENERAL ELECTION**
_“American Dream” Captures Sen. Min’s
Family History and Legislative Experience_
**IRVINE, CA** — Today, Dave Min for Congress placed its first ad buy of the general election. The six-figure ad buy delves into Min’s biography, as well as his work advocating for Orange County families throughout his career.
Watch The Spot Here: **[](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=ccfd6f8dbb&e=7017cc100e)**
_It’s a story that’s only possible in America._ _My parents: immigrants who survived the Korean war. My children: with endless possibilities._ _That’s the promise of America–and I spent my career fighting to protect it._ _I’m Dave Min._ _I prosecuted Wall Street corruption._ _Fought for more affordable housing._ _And went after the financial speculators jacking up home prices._ _I’m running for Congress to build an economy that works for everyone. Cause everyone deserves a fair shot at the American Dream._ ### _California’s 47th is an open_[ _DCCC Red To Blue_](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=41b0acd528&e=7017cc100e) _Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Democratic Representative Katie Porter is not running for re-election. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this_[ _“toss up”_](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=550aeb73d6&e=7017cc100e) _district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country._

Voters in Wisconsin made their voices heard loud and clear in Tuesday’s Primary Election --_**THEY’RE READY FOR CHANGE!!**_

They’re fed up with Tammy Baldwin’s radical Leftist agenda that has left Wisconsin families behind and crushed the American Dream for future generations.

Friend -- Tomorrow morning at 11 am, join me, Helga Zepp-LaRouche, Scott Ritter, Ray Mc Govern and others for the 63rd weekly International Peace Coalition zoom meeting. | [](https://www.sareforsenate.com/r?u=rWeo0T8catXg17FnJdKclV9S3tTFY-VoHf27ektZr9Qj9gksqwhUCq9xY_5i8mDjhsUONwqmxnCpOqmCLeefDM5dOuMCi25baKXVe7jlDlw&e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240816_ipc&n=2 "RSVP for Zoom Link for Fri. 11 am") [RSVP for Zoom Link for Fri. 11 am](https://www.sareforsenate.com/r?u=rWeo0T8catXg17FnJdKclV9S3tTFY-VoHf27ektZr9Qj9gksqwhUCq9xY_5i8mDjhsUONwqmxnCpOqmCLeefDM5dOuMCi25baKXVe7jlDlw&e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240816_ipc&n=2)
---
Over the past month and more, NATO’S War Party has gone into lethal overdrive, in both Southwest Asia (Gaza) and Central Europe (Ukraine), placing the world on the brink of nuclear war. This Friday, the International Peace Coalition will be addressed by Scott Ritter. Ritter is an intelligence officer, military analyst, and former chief weapons inspector to Iraq, 1991-1998 [United Nations Special Commission (UNSCOM)](https://www.sareforsenate.com/r?u=3N58NApzqcKjOGfD3BVlV5RvlGFYseGFdI26j25iKEl9Dz3zvEnNXcUnvfIYWUcfmfrQLgjLulwT1-v7z7K-e9eOZ20OerSdyRi5noBseIUVTEnksjb_m5pXnvxbVcIGHnfaKF_7vS64nazxJvMA4Suyw87bzU2z_5tNgkBX5Kk&e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240816_ipc&n=3) in Iraq 1991-1998, charged with finding and destroying all [weapons of mass destruction](https://www.sareforsenate.com/r?u=3N58NApzqcKjOGfD3BVlV5RvlGFYseGFdI26j25iKEl9Dz3zvEnNXcUnvfIYWUcfmfrQLgjLulwT1-v7z7K-e9eOZ20OerSdyRi5noBseIX1n83XejcNI2xd8-TRn5oMoGTr7eSz16plHIFenHsvxEge3Q4t0fEVBL1_0fJRCBI&e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240816_ipc&n=4). Since then, he has been targeted and harassed by elements of the State Department and other American federal agencies, and has been placed, along with IPC co-founder Helga Zepp-LaRouche, Independent United States Senate candidate Diane Sare, and several others, on “Ukrainian Intelligence” hit lists. His life, and the lives of others, are in immediate danger, true, but they are the beginning.
For all of us, this is a “Martin Niemoller moment.” Niemoller, a clergyman in 1930s Germany, said:
_“First, they came for the socialists, and I did not speak out — because I was not a socialist. Then they came for the trade unionists, and I did not speak out— because I was not a trade unionist.
_
_Then they came for the Jews, and I did not speak out—because I was not a Jew. Then they came for me—and there was no one left to speak for me.”_
We have seen the double-headed monster of the war in Southwest Asia (Gaza) and the war in Europe (Ukraine), either or both of which can lead “unexpectedly” to thermonuclear confrontation very quickly. Ukraine’s no-longer-legal President Zelensky, probably with the blessing of London and Washington, has launched a foredoomed but destructive “Battle of the Bulge” invasion of the Kursk region of Russia. Then, there is Netanyahu’s NATO-endorsed mass murder of perhaps 200,000 Palestinians, mostly women and children, in the name of “self-defense.” Netanyahu and Zelensky are both attempting to make negotiations impossible, and total war inevitable. The two-headed monster has one purpose—to draw the US, Germany, and other NATO countries into direct military confrontation with Russia, with the extraordinary danger that entails.
But this need not be so. Proposals for a new security and development architecture, including that circulated by the International Peace Coalition, and by governments such as China and Brazil, addressing both Gaza and Ukraine, are in circulation. Assassination and threat of assassination are being used to prevent progress, either through murder, or through intimidation.
If you not only believe in freedom of thought, but in preserving and defending it, you must join this meeting this Friday and urge others to attend. Last week the IPC brought together 550 individuals from 50 nations, and widely divergent political affiliations, as we must. There is a higher principle that must unite us. As Zepp-LaRouche states in her Ten Principles: “A New World economic order is emerging, involving the vast majority of the countries of the global south. The European nations in the US must not fight this effort, but by joining hands with the developing countries, cooperate to shape the next epoch of the development of the human species to become a renaissance of the highest and most noble expressions of creativity!”
Join the International Peace Coalition this **Friday at 11am EDT.** We will be joined with former U.N. weapons inspector and U.S. Marine intelligence officer, **Scott Ritter** , Executive Director of Friends of Sabeel of North America, **Jonathan Kuttab** , Co-Founder of Nonviolence International, former CIA analyst and co-founder of the Veteran Intelligence Professionals for Sanity (VIPS), **Ray McGovern, Prof. Henry Baldelomar,** Chargé d'Affaires of the Bolivian Embassy in Washington, D.C.and others.
WHEN
August 16, 2024, 11am ET

Tomorrow marks two years since the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) was signed into law delivering historic health protections for Americans.

But Trump and Vance’s Project 2025 threatens all of the incredible progress we’ve seen in the last two years with a call to repeal the IRA, threatening access to affordable care for millions of Americans.

**[That’s why the Harris-Walz campaign is calling on healthcare professionals to sign this open letter to protect the IRA from Republican efforts to repeal it.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.yjJN_MEbNx94PLaWzZ6hWwGamPY7W-vS4bGbFoLcGE_goybYzUFubWM_2Su_UtRT4g3Y7EsJAL5Zi87-Qti9WkTJ0kV0do78ibyWoeMezHsYQdmgj9ojyo2pX5M68Zi5k16Qu_vSNQyGB72U16HAFI6czlDvKEB71E5Fhingr107szkZOrU4KGwJVvWrZpbTjLT5wK4EZgzfm5Bp2LRmO3U3GpqVVOtKK6Us6rbQnBjeHil7DC-NaIi4LTDzHIAxwTbN8S42qwv91TCiu0yalEw42NEcg2eZeT-Zq-Ee0elQ6byzDDZbSYyiUdzJK0yVDG1D5_4Vkz5EMzb7NzoGLj-BF29WKAsc_S2fDPgSFAsPlKsyAGRsnqewdKn1QV9GLPthcCbFIcbaDD-YWYgfhx92wEVbKTFHcuR1Y0x5gyDARj3L3kNL--RLrfbMKji3/48x/mF_0507KRdOxmpXMlkWhTw/h1/h001.o8K4bqsOiJeltKYvnQV5ie8Z61KLZYq-dpDXIHn1E6A)** | | [SIGN THE LETTER](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.yjJN_MEbNx94PLaWzZ6hWwGamPY7W-vS4bGbFoLcGE_goybYzUFubWM_2Su_UtRT4g3Y7EsJAL5Zi87-Qti9WkTJ0kV0do78ibyWoeMezHsYQdmgj9ojyo2pX5M68Zi5k16Qu_vSNQyGB72U16HAFI6czlDvKEB71E5Fhingr107szkZOrU4KGwJVvWrZpbTjLT5wK4EZgzfm5Bp2LRmO3U3GpqVVOtKK6Us6rbQnBgx6x_-G2FTBCXuTTpBUvwXj4VQGuWim42CqVz2vnGK4Oq96qpL4B1DIywDysfR2KjCkbEqnSpbj8WSwyOGsdIZIlZkm0r-nvcw71lsbIpXHWzulq7Ga6FHpRYuINN9S5YXb12j-BWpXx5gx3e7a3BjufoC_VX28APnFUi6F0UDKiyzzF0DZwoJFa-TyAWZ2YrmO9iqrBsFulP9ykgu1imU/48x/mF_0507KRdOxmpXMlkWhTw/h2/h001.r47u0u09TXCWtmZQOa3VkIGd7QJwT_QYtbYwB6YT7-Y)

Here’s what we’re at risk of losing under a Trump-Vance administration:

* Expanded health care for millions of Americans -- today, more people have health insurance than ever before
* A lower cost of health insurance for millions of Americans
* An insulin cap of $35 per month for people with Medicare
* Zero out-of-pocket costs for vaccines against shingles, tetanus, hepatitis, and more for people on Medicare and adults on Medicaid
* Lowered prescription drug costs -- limited annual out-of-pocket prescription drug costs at $2,000 for over 14 million people on Medicare
* Medicare’s ability to negotiate the price of prescription drugs with Big Pharma for the first time
* Groundbreaking investments in a clean energy economy to protect Americans from the health impacts of climate change and fossil fuel pollution

Too many families and children struggle to afford medical care, we have to continue making progress to increase affordability and lower costs.

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Recent polls show Nella within the margin of error in her race for the U.S. Senate seat against the entrenched incumbent, Martin Heinrich. She also outraised him last quarter! I’ve seen firsthand how transformative it is to work with a Republican majority in Congress. During my time as Speaker of the House, the balance of power made all the difference in advancing a conservative agenda that worked FOR the People. Imagine what we can achieve if we elect Nella Domenici,finally flip New Mexico red, and take back the Senate. Nella is a strong, principled, independent leader who will stand up for our values and work tirelessly to bring common-sense solutions to the Senate. Her commitment to border security, economic growth, and restoring American strength is exactly what New Mexico – and our country – needs right now. The stakes are high, and the radical left is pouring a ton of resources to hold onto seats like this one in New Mexico. So please, let’s seize the moment and make history together. Thank you for standing with us in this critical fight. Warm regards, Newt Gingrich P.S. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. name: Andrew Yang
subject: Defending Democracy
body:
If Democrats are serious about defending democracy, there are a number of things that they should commit to. | |
---
| | |
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=4873ad385d&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
|
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=3b996976f0&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
| I was asked to write an [Op-Ed for Newsweek](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=86762a1951&e=0f227c2ae3) about the Democrats and democracy. Here's what I wrote — hope you enjoy it.

_**I Hope Harris Wins. But the Democrats Need to Answer for Their Failures to Protect Democracy**_

Vice President Kamala Harris and Governor Tim Walz have been enjoying a honeymoon period in the presidential race that I expect will last at least through the convention. Their rise has caught former President Trump and GOP VP Nominee JD Vance flatfooted.

I myself endorsed Kamala Harris shortly after Joe Biden stepped aside. I am someone who finds Donald Trump to have the wrong character and makeup to be President. I ran for the office four years ago in part to try and keep him from returning.

And yet Donald Trump may win in November. After all, he won in 2016 and was about 43,000 swing voters away from winning again in 2020.

For months I have been dreading Trump's return to power. Why? The Democratic nominee was Joe Biden, who I thought would obviously lose to Trump, handing him back the keys without a fight.

It's easily forgotten, but if not for the early debate on June 27th, Joe Biden would be the nominee right now, and we would all be subject to endless stories about how he's still got it or is as sharp as a tack, despite overwhelming evidence of his decline. If Trump had simply delayed the first debate until after the conventions, when they customarily take place, he would be on the fast track to the presidency today.

Democrats are fond of saying "Democracy is on the line" when they talk about Donald Trump. Trump denied he lost the 2020 election and hoped to overturn it via an angry mob. We can easily imagine him refusing to accept defeat in November. And yet Democrats were inches away from handing him back the reins of power because of an unwillingness to challenge Joe Biden, who was clearly too old and faltering to run for re-election.

I saw Joe Biden dozens of times on the trail four years ago. I was on stage with him for seven primary debates. Back then, he was aging but vital. I saw him earlier this year in South Carolina, and his decline was evident. He hardly seemed like the same person; the last four years have taken a significant toll, as they might for anyone in his early eighties with such a stressful, demanding role.

One sitting Democrat made the case that Joe Biden was too old and infirm in the primaries—Congressman Dean Phillips. Dean's reward? Ostracization by his own party. A primary challenger for his congressional seat backed by an establishment eager to punish him. A premature end to his political career. Dean Phillips demonstrated more principle, courage and heart than all of the putative leaders in his party who were at the time falling over themselves to bolster Joe and brand Dean an outcast, only for Dean's case to be proven right less than six months later.

If Democrats are serious about defending democracy, there are a number of things that they should commit to.

First, they should pledge to hold robust primaries no matter what. They did not this cycle, canceling state primaries without a single vote being cast and refusing to hold debates, with the logic being that Joe was an incumbent and incumbents shouldn't have challengers. That is asinine. If an incumbent can't easily dispatch challengers from within their own party, they are probably not going to fare well in November. We saw that very clearly this year. Imagine if Joe's decline had been evident back in January; there could have been a genuine process that would have introduced the nation to the next generation of leadership.

Second, they should stop boosting election deniers. The Democratic Party has been in the habit of spending millions boosting extreme candidates like Doug Mastriano and Joe Gibbs in Republican primaries so that they have easier opponents in the general election. This may seem like smart politics, but it is cynical and accelerates the general loss of faith and confidence in our institutions.

Third, they should stop fighting measures like open primaries and ranked choice voting that promise to make the system more dynamic. Open primaries in particular simply enable more voters to vote. Democrats spend millions of dollars against these measures every year across the country including for this November. Ranked choice voting gives people the chance to vote their true preferences.

Democracy does not mean, "you must vote for us." Democracy means listening to the people and giving them real voice and choice.

One proven means of combating polarization is local news. Over 3,000 local newspapers have gone out of business the past two decades, to be replaced by social media feeds and cable news. Democrats should be supporting the Community News and Small Business Support Act that provides a tax credit for local businesses and publications. If you read local news you're more likely to vote in local elections.

51 percent of Americans now self-categorize as Independents, according to Gallup, and an even higher proportion of young people don't subscribe to either party. There is a bill in Congress called the Fair Representation Act. It would shift congressional districts, which currently have one representative, to new, bigger districts that would have multiple representatives from different parties. Some would be neither Democrats nor Republicans. This would give rise to new voices in our country and make us more resilient to authoritarianism because there would be more seats at the table that are not beholden to the leadership of one party or the other.

You know what would attract droves of Independent voters? Term limits for members of Congress. 75 percent of Americans are for them as we sense that our leaders are more and more divorced from the day-to-day of their constituents. Banning stock trading for members falls into the same category.

If Kamala Harris and the Democrats are triumphant in November, there will likely be much celebration and self-congratulation. I certainly hope the Harris-Walz ticket wins. But will they actually replenish democracy? Or will they say, "See, we were right all along!"

If history is any indication, they'll fail to do much while in power to truly modernize our democracy. Getting term limits, multi-member districts, and ranked-choice voting ratified into law have failed again and again, even with Democrats in power.

If Democrats start standing up for democracy in action instead of rhetoric, the country will be far better off. If not, new characters will continue to push for change, and Democrats will find themselves increasingly at odds with the people they claim to represent.
---
| **
Andrew Yang**

clean_body: If Democrats are serious about defending democracy, there are a number of things that they should commit to. | | | | | | | | | I was asked to write an about the Democrats and democracy. Here's what I wrote — hope you enjoy it. I Hope Harris Wins. But the Democrats Need to Answer for Their Failures to Protect Democracy Vice President Kamala Harris and Governor Tim Walz have been enjoying a honeymoon period in the presidential race that I expect will last at least through the convention. Their rise has caught former President Trump and GOP VP Nominee JD Vance flatfooted. I myself endorsed Kamala Harris shortly after Joe Biden stepped aside. I am someone who finds Donald Trump to have the wrong character and makeup to be President. I ran for the office four years ago in part to try and keep him from returning. And yet Donald Trump may win in November. After all, he won in 2016 and was about 43,000 swing voters away from winning again in 2020. For months I have been dreading Trump's return to power. Why? The Democratic nominee was Joe Biden, who I thought would obviously lose to Trump, handing him back the keys without a fight. It's easily forgotten, but if not for the early debate on June 27th, Joe Biden would be the nominee right now, and we would all be subject to endless stories about how he's still got it or is as sharp as a tack, despite overwhelming evidence of his decline. If Trump had simply delayed the first debate until after the conventions, when they customarily take place, he would be on the fast track to the presidency today. Democrats are fond of saying "Democracy is on the line" when they talk about Donald Trump. Trump denied he lost the 2020 election and hoped to overturn it via an angry mob. We can easily imagine him refusing to accept defeat in November. And yet Democrats were inches away from handing him back the reins of power because of an unwillingness to challenge Joe Biden, who was clearly too old and faltering to run for re-election. I saw Joe Biden dozens of times on the trail four years ago. I was on stage with him for seven primary debates. Back then, he was aging but vital. I saw him earlier this year in South Carolina, and his decline was evident. He hardly seemed like the same person; the last four years have taken a significant toll, as they might for anyone in his early eighties with such a stressful, demanding role. One sitting Democrat made the case that Joe Biden was too old and infirm in the primaries—Congressman Dean Phillips. Dean's reward? Ostracization by his own party. A primary challenger for his congressional seat backed by an establishment eager to punish him. A premature end to his political career. Dean Phillips demonstrated more principle, courage and heart than all of the putative leaders in his party who were at the time falling over themselves to bolster Joe and brand Dean an outcast, only for Dean's case to be proven right less than six months later. If Democrats are serious about defending democracy, there are a number of things that they should commit to. First, they should pledge to hold robust primaries no matter what. They did not this cycle, canceling state primaries without a single vote being cast and refusing to hold debates, with the logic being that Joe was an incumbent and incumbents shouldn't have challengers. That is asinine. If an incumbent can't easily dispatch challengers from within their own party, they are probably not going to fare well in November. We saw that very clearly this year. Imagine if Joe's decline had been evident back in January; there could have been a genuine process that would have introduced the nation to the next generation of leadership. Second, they should stop boosting election deniers. The Democratic Party has been in the habit of spending millions boosting extreme candidates like Doug Mastriano and Joe Gibbs in Republican primaries so that they have easier opponents in the general election. This may seem like smart politics, but it is cynical and accelerates the general loss of faith and confidence in our institutions. Third, they should stop fighting measures like open primaries and ranked choice voting that promise to make the system more dynamic. Open primaries in particular simply enable more voters to vote. Democrats spend millions of dollars against these measures every year across the country including for this November. Ranked choice voting gives people the chance to vote their true preferences. Democracy does not mean, "you must vote for us." Democracy means listening to the people and giving them real voice and choice. One proven means of combating polarization is local news. Over 3,000 local newspapers have gone out of business the past two decades, to be replaced by social media feeds and cable news. Democrats should be supporting the Community News and Small Business Support Act that provides a tax credit for local businesses and publications. If you read local news you're more likely to vote in local elections. 51 percent of Americans now self-categorize as Independents, according to Gallup, and an even higher proportion of young people don't subscribe to either party. There is a bill in Congress called the Fair Representation Act. It would shift congressional districts, which currently have one representative, to new, bigger districts that would have multiple representatives from different parties. Some would be neither Democrats nor Republicans. This would give rise to new voices in our country and make us more resilient to authoritarianism because there would be more seats at the table that are not beholden to the leadership of one party or the other. You know what would attract droves of Independent voters? Term limits for members of Congress. 75 percent of Americans are for them as we sense that our leaders are more and more divorced from the day-to-day of their constituents. Banning stock trading for members falls into the same category. If Kamala Harris and the Democrats are triumphant in November, there will likely be much celebration and self-congratulation. I certainly hope the Harris-Walz ticket wins. But will they actually replenish democracy? Or will they say, "See, we were right all along!" If history is any indication, they'll fail to do much while in power to truly modernize our democracy. Getting term limits, multi-member districts, and ranked-choice voting ratified into law have failed again and again, even with Democrats in power. If Democrats start standing up for democracy in action instead of rhetoric, the country will be far better off. If not, new characters will continue to push for change, and Democrats will find themselves increasingly at odds with the people they claim to represent. | Andrew Yang Co-Chair, Forward Party | | | Want to change how you receive these emails? Friends,
I’m so honored to officially be the Democratic nominee for Minnesota’s 8th congressional district. We won our primary with over 90% of the vote – proving that folks really do believe there is a better way forward.
But now with the primary election behind us, we’re fully focused on the sprint toward election day in November. We have our work cut out for us, but we know that if we can fully execute our campaign plan we can actually unseat Pete Stauber.
As the general election officially gets underway, I’m personally asking for your support again. Can you make a grassroots donation to our campaign for Congress today and join us in our work to flip this seat blue? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/schultz-august-2024?refcode=20240815]
If you've saved your information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process immediately

DONATE ANOTHER AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/schultz-august-2024?refcode=20240815]
There is a certain energy that we are feeling – not just across the 8th, but across the country. There was enthusiasm in 2022 – don’t get me wrong – but something special is in the air right now.
I really believe that we can win this race. Pete Stauber has had his opportunity to make life better for the folks in our district. But instead, he has only to fueled political division, spread misinformation, and failed to pass any meaningful legislation.
In Congress, I’ll fight every day for families across the 8th. I will work with Republicans, Democrats, and anyone interested in a better way forward.
So please, make a donation to our campaign today and let’s get this general election campaign started! → [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/schultz-august-2024?refcode=20240815]
Thank you,
Jen
Democrat Jen Schultz is running for Congress in Minnesota's 8th district against MAGA Republican Pete Stauber. Jen is committed to building a better way forward for our community.

subject: The fight for Wisconsin's Senate seat is on
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE
body:
| We need to support Tammy’s reelection campaign.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=3354%2E35263%2EAmw_mO)
[](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-aug24.RD8FO-&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240815_AM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=3354%2E35263%2EAmw_mO) Hi Peter — it’s Ben Wikler, Chair of the Democratic Party of Wisconsin. There were so many major political moments in Wisconsin last month — if you blinked, you might have missed one. First, **Donald Trump** and **JD Vance** held their Republican National Convention right here in Milwaukee. Then, after launching her presidential campaign, **Kamala Harris** held a rally in Wisconsin as the very first stop on her campaign trail. Now, Wisconsin’s primary has officially ended, setting up a showdown between **Tammy Baldwin** and **Eric Hovde** for our competitive Senate seat. **With the general election underway, we need to support Tammy’s reelection campaign against her out-of-touch, self-funding megamillionaire opponent.** All eyes _have been_ on Wisconsin, and all eyes _will be_ on Wisconsin through November 5th. It’s no secret that control of the White House and the Senate majority runs right through our state. Friend, This week, Congresswoman Ilhan Omar won her primary election despite a recent influx in right-wing spending against her. Her “Democratic” opponent courted votes from Republicans and took right-wing money. Some of her opponent’s donors sent now-leaked messages to each other, revealing their Islamophobic views and their hopes to see “alt right Christian neo Nazis” in our government. **Racist Republican donors keep spending big in Democratic primary elections, and now they’re emboldened to interfere even more.** With funds from pro-Trump billionaires, AIPAC spent more than $25 million to take down two other Black members of our congressional Squad this summer -- making Cori Bush and Jamaal Bowman’s primary elections the most expensive ever in U.S. history. We can’t let right-wing billionaires keep buying our elections. **We need to push back against these attacks on our democracy and show the strength of our progressive movement.** That includes supporting candidates who represent the people rather than anti-democratic special interests, like **Florida State Representative Angie Nixon** , whose primary election is coming up next Tuesday. Angie’s a community organizer and a true public servant. disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
My name is Conor McGuire and I’m the new Director of Development at Leaders We Deserve.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240815&t=1&akid=1059%2E587540%2E38OQLV)
Hey Peter, it’s Conor!
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240815?refcode=em20240815&refcode2=1059_587540_38OQLV&akid=1059%2E587540%2E38OQLV)
**It’s been a month since I joined the team at Leaders We Deserve as the new Director of Development — and what a ride it has been so far!**
You’ll be hearing more from me via email with critical updates about Leaders We Deserve, so I thought I would introduce myself.
Here’s a little bit about me: I’m originally from Cleveland, Ohio, so naturally I’m a _rabid_ fan of the Cavaliers and Guardians. I graduated from Loyola Chicago, and I've worked on political campaigns from the moment I completed my education.
**In fact, in the 72 hours after I walked across the stage, I drove 900 miles to Norfolk, Virginia, and immediately got to work knocking on doors and getting out the vote.** Since that day, I've never taken more than four weeks away without applying for or working on a campaign.
Now, I’m very excited to be working with David Hogg to elect young, progressive leaders up-and-down the ballot,_especially during one of the most important elections in American history._
**Thanks to support from grassroots supporters like you, Peter, Leaders We Deserve has grown into a leading, progressive movement that refuses to take money from corporations or special interests.[Can you donate $5 to support our work to elect America’s future progressive leaders?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240815?refcode=em20240815&amount=5&refcode2=1059_587540_38OQLV&akid=1059%2E587540%2E38OQLV)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240815?amount=5&refcode=em20240815-1059&refcode2=1059_587540_38OQLV&akid=1059%2E587540%2E38OQLV)**
I have known and admired David as a public voice for years. As I got to know him throughout the interview process, it became even clearer to me that he is a leader with integrity. **Who David is in the public spotlight is exactly who he is in private.**
_**That’s rare in politics!**_
It’s one of the reasons I'm so excited to be working with him to help him achieve this organization’s goals, **which includes helping launch the careers of our amazing slate of candidates running for state legislatures** — all without accepting donations from private corporations.
Everyone at Leaders We Deserve believes that if we do our jobs well enough, the need for our organization will go away. The issue of money in politics has become a serious issue, so we’re proud to be doing the work to put elections back in the hands of the people.
Leaders We Deserve has successfully invested in (and won!) the campaigns of young, progressive candidates like Nadarius Clark, Molly Cook, and Oscar De Los Santos. **And we're riding full force into the upcoming election with the intention of getting ALL of our candidates elected.**
**[But we need your help! Will you give $5 right now to help support our mission? With your support, we can elect young, progressive leaders all over the country, and secure a better future for generations to come.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240815?refcode=em20240815&amount=5&refcode2=1059_587540_38OQLV&akid=1059%2E587540%2E38OQLV)**

Let’s do this!
**Conor McGuire**
Director of Development
Leaders We Deserve

name: Natalie Jones
subject: 🗞️ In Today’s Headlines: Results of Medicare Price Negotiations 🗞️
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Freedom Virginia, Inc
body:
freedomva.org [freedomva.org]
Friends-
One year ago, Medicare gained the authority to negotiate directly with pharmaceutical companies to lower prices for certain high-cost prescription drugs covered by Medicare as part of the Inflation Reduction Act. Today, the results of those negotiations have been released. [https://www.whitehouse.gov/briefing-room/statements-releases/2024/08/15/fact-sheet-biden-harris-administration-announces-new-lower-prices-for-first-ten-drugs-selected-for-medicare-price-negotiation-to-lower-costs-for-millions-of-americans/]
https://www.whitehouse.gov/briefing-room/statements-releases/2024/08/15/fact-sheet-biden-harris-administration-announces-new-lower-prices-for-first-ten-drugs-selected-for-medicare-price-negotiation-to-lower-costs-for-millions-of-americans/ [https://www.whitehouse.gov/briefing-room/statements-releases/2024/08/15/fact-sheet-biden-harris-administration-announces-new-lower-prices-for-first-ten-drugs-selected-for-medicare-price-negotiation-to-lower-costs-for-millions-of-americans/]
Ten of the most expensive drugs treating issues ranging from cancer and diabetes to blood clots were chosen for the first round of price negotiations. These new, reduced prices- alongside efforts to cap out-of-pocket drug costs at $3,500 and rebates on drugs whose prices have risen higher than the rate of inflation- are expected to save the 314,000 Virginians on Medicare over 83 million dollars.
While this is incredible news for those on Medicare, over 7 million Virginians are not eligible for Medicare and will remain severely burdened by the cost of prescription drugs. That’s why we need a Prescription Drug Affordability Board (PDAB) in Virginia, a board of health and medical experts who would build on the power of Medicare to review the prices of certain high-cost drugs and set payment limits for consumers. This year, two bills that would’ve created a Virginia PDAB [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+sum+SB274] were vetoed by Governor Glenn Youngkin; if you have a story about how the cost of prescription drugs has affected your life, share it with us here [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd1corcX24sU8SGyHsLsdf0sOYMn0IUnWer5EUKDjaPTcrszw/viewform?usp=sf_link] . We share these stories with legislators to highlight the importance of affordability measures like a PDAB.
As we celebrate the good work being done by Medicare, we will continue the fight to ensure Virginians have access to affordable life-saving medicine.
Thank you for your continued support!
Natalie Jones
Digital Manager

This year, two bills that would’ve created a Virginia PDAB [] were vetoed by Governor Glenn Youngkin; if you have a story about how the cost of prescription drugs has affected your life, share it with us here [] . We share these stories with legislators to highlight the importance of affordability measures like a PDAB. As we celebrate the good work being done by Medicare, we will continue the fight to ensure Virginians have access to affordable life-saving medicine. Thank you for your continued support! | | Friend, Though the results of this week's Republican primary election in Northeast Wisconsin were not what I had hoped, I am proud of the campaign that we ran. I am – and always will be – grateful for the support that you gave me. I want to thank everyone who stood with me during my campaign for Congress, but especially my wife, sons, and family. Their belief in me, along with the desire to represent my community, served as the motivation for my campaign. I have always felt called to serve. I felt called to serve our country in the Air National Guard, to serve my community as a homebuilder and state legislator, to serve God as a person of faith. This desire to fight for our freedoms and beliefs was why I ran for Congress, and it is why I remain committed to helping Republicans win in November. I want to wish our Republican nominee, Tony Wied, well as he moves onto the general election. Over the next couple months, I will do everything possible to help elect Republicans – from Donald Trump to Eric Hovde to legislative candidates – in November and moving forward, I will continue to seek out ways to help America meet its challenges. Thank you for believing in me and for your support of my campaign. I look forward to seeing you out on the trail this Fall,
---
Roger

What if I told you that since Donald Trump lost in 2020, more than 19 million Americans have been purged from the voter rolls? It's true, it's a problem that has increased in its severity over the last two decades, and right now it threatens to permanently undermine our democracy altogether. [The Brennan Center for Justice reports](https://substack.com/redirect/85fa6834-682d-4823-89f1-a347dd2ec722?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> According to the U.S. Election Assistance Commission, over 19 million voters were removed from the rolls between 2020 and 2022. That is an increase of 21 percent compared with 2014-16, which was already an increase of 33 percent from the number of voters removed between 2006 and 2008.
For as much as Republicans scream about [non-existent voter fraud](https://substack.com/redirect/7d87aadc-4688-4820-9474-6665323e6f56?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), they are leading the charge on voter suppression. Predictably, legacy media is ignoring this crisis, but if we do not act now, we risk losing our democracy forever. **Let 's Address This**.

## Voter suppression invites fascism
Republican states are leading the way in voter suppression via voter purges. And if we don't work quickly to ensure comprehensive federal voting rights legislation, we will devolve into permanent fascism. This isn't hyperbole. Let's look at the facts.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/861cf067-fe14-41a5-a864-b32a3cd4d8f7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
In swing state Georgia, [Republicans have purged thousands of voters from the voter rolls for no reason and without explanation](https://substack.com/redirect/37d2cb47-7c86-4dd1-9f41-3a2b7ebd723c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Remember how Donald Trump wanted to "find" some 12,000 votes? Republicans are now doing the work for him.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5e389c5e-c768-44bd-93f1-67ecfb8695e6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Swing state Arizona is even worse. Arizona voter purge, with [Republicans suing to remove at least 500,000 voters from voter rolls](https://substack.com/redirect/7fdf2df5-5e6c-4786-91b8-b1047c3be615?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Again, given that Biden won Arizona in 2020 by a mere 11,000 votes, purging half a million voters to reduce turnout is the difference between Arizona going red or blue in the 2024 election.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6d0df2b0-df84-401c-8c61-1aaf81447dde?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And while I can cite numerous more examples of fascist voter purges, no one tops Texas. [Texas is purging or suspending a shocking 2.1 million voters](https://substack.com/redirect/bd852495-2c0d-4860-addb-c5f5f46a629c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), disproportionately low income and disproportionately Black and brown. In 2020 Trump won Texas by only 660,000 votes out of more than 11 million votes cast. Suspending 2.1 million votes is a concrete way to ensure Texas stays red. This is why many voting rights activists have long said that Texas is not a red state, it is a voter suppression state, and the facts prove this truth.

## Voter suppression goes beyond voter purges
And it isn't only voter purges. Republicans are employing a number of unethical, discriminatory, and downright racist strategies to suppress the vote. Strategies that mimic the poll taxes, grandfather clauses, and literacy tests of yesteryear. And due to the Supreme Court gutting the Voting Rights Act in Shelby v. Holder, these red states are able to get away with this modern day Jim Crow. A sample of these established Republican tactics to suppress the vote include:
* Requiring voter IDs even after voters provided an ID at the time of voter registration
* Banning only certain forms of voter IDs disproportionately used by Black or minority groups
* Accepting only certain forms of voter IDs disproportionately used by white or affluent voters
* Racial gerrymandering that disproportionately represents white voters over non-white voters
* Police target and charge Black people at higher rates, disenfranchising them
* Longer sentences for Black Americans, blocking them from more elections
* Prison gerrymandering, where Black incarcerated people are denied voting but counted for redistricting
* Requiring formerly incarcerated people to pay court fees before voting
* Requiring people to take off work and lose money just to vote
* Banning Sunday "Souls to the Polls" early voting, which targets Black voters
* "Running out" of voter registration or ballot forms
* Purging voters, requiring constant re-registration
* Refusing to accommodate non-English speaking voters
* Denying curbside voting for people with disabilities
* Denying absentee or mail in ballot voting, especially for the elderly, military, and indigent
* Requiring a home address, disenfranchising ~600K homeless Americans
* Partisan poll workers
* Inadequate or closed down polling locations on Native American lands
* Changing polling locations without proper advanced notice
* Limiting public transportation on Election Day
* Arbitrary or subjective signature verification requirements

I can go on but point is--**none** of the above is hypothetical. **All** of it is real and is happening as we speak. Each form of suppression chips away at access and has the potential to flip an election. Remember, it isn't necessary to ban entire demographics of 'undesirable' voters--it is only necessary to ban enough, even 1-2%, to flip a close election.
Despite this suppression, BIPOC voters are still organizing and winning elections. But imagine what would happen if these barriers to free and fair voting were removed? America would change forever--and that's what scares Republicans the most. As a side note, I find it ironic that the same people who scream "all lives matter" and "I don't see color"--suddenly see color just fine while denying voting rights to non-white voters.

## In Conclusion
As the late great John Lewis once said, "Democracy is not a state--it is an act." We cannot have a more perfect union built on justice unless we have equal voting rights. And until we elect leaders who reflect the diversity of the American experience, we prevent our own progress. We must be in this for the long haul. Despite our exhaustion, we must continue to act on the local, state, and federal level to protect voting rights and thus protect our republic.

A reminder to check your voter status and also recognize just how close we are to losing our democracy altogether | | | Aug 15 | | | | | | | | | | | | What if I told you that since Donald Trump lost in 2020, more than 19 million Americans have been purged from the voter rolls? It's true, it's a problem that has increased in its severity over the last two decades, and right now it threatens to permanently undermine our democracy altogether. : According to the U.S. Election Assistance Commission, over 19 million voters were removed from the rolls between 2020 and 2022. That is an increase of 21 percent compared with 2014-16, which was already an increase of 33 percent from the number of voters removed between 2006 and 2008. For as much as Republicans scream about , they are leading the charge on voter suppression. Predictably, legacy media is ignoring this crisis, but if we do not act now, we risk losing our democracy forever. Let 's Address This. | | ---|---|--- A man holds a sign with "Voter Suppression" crossed out, while standing in front of the White House. Credit: AFJ.org Voter suppression invites fascism Republican states are leading the way in voter suppression via voter purges. And if we don't work quickly to ensure comprehensive federal voting rights legislation, we will devolve into permanent fascism. This isn't hyperbole. Let's look at the facts. | | ---|---|--- In swing state Georgia, . Remember how Donald Trump wanted to "find" some 12,000 votes? Republicans are now doing the work for him. | | ---|---|--- Swing state Arizona is even worse. Arizona voter purge, with . Again, given that Biden won Arizona in 2020 by a mere 11,000 votes, purging half a million voters to reduce turnout is the difference between Arizona going red or blue in the 2024 election. | | ---|---|--- And while I can cite numerous more examples of fascist voter purges, no one tops Texas. , disproportionately low income and disproportionately Black and brown. In 2020 Trump won Texas by only 660,000 votes out of more than 11 million votes cast. Suspending 2.1 million votes is a concrete way to ensure Texas stays red. This is why many voting rights activists have long said that Texas is not a red state, it is a voter suppression state, and the facts prove this truth. Voter suppression goes beyond voter purges And it isn't only voter purges. Republicans are employing a number of unethical, discriminatory, and downright racist strategies to suppress the vote. Strategies that mimic the poll taxes, grandfather clauses, and literacy tests of yesteryear. And due to the Supreme Court gutting the Voting Rights Act in Shelby v. Holder, these red states are able to get away with this modern day Jim Crow. A sample of these established Republican tactics to suppress the vote include: Requiring voter IDs even after voters provided an ID at the time of voter registration Banning only certain forms of voter IDs disproportionately used by Black or minority groups Accepting only certain forms of voter IDs disproportionately used by white or affluent voters Racial gerrymandering that disproportionately represents white voters over non-white voters Police target and charge Black people at higher rates, disenfranchising them Longer sentences for Black Americans, blocking them from more elections Prison gerrymandering, where Black incarcerated people are denied voting but counted for redistricting Requiring formerly incarcerated people to pay court fees before voting Requiring people to take off work and lose money just to vote Banning Sunday "Souls to the Polls" early voting, which targets Black voters "Running out" of voter registration or ballot forms Purging voters, requiring constant re-registration Refusing to accommodate non-English speaking voters Denying curbside voting for people with disabilities Denying absentee or mail in ballot voting, especially for the elderly, military, and indigent Requiring a home address, disenfranchising ~600K homeless Americans Partisan poll workers Inadequate or closed down polling locations on Native American lands Changing polling locations without proper advanced notice Limiting public transportation on Election Day Arbitrary or subjective signature verification requirements I can go on but point is--none of the above is hypothetical. All of it is real and is happening as we speak. Each form of suppression chips away at access and has the potential to flip an election. Remember, it isn't necessary to ban entire demographics of 'undesirable' voters--it is only necessary to ban enough, even 1-2%, to flip a close election. Despite this suppression, BIPOC voters are still organizing and winning elections. But imagine what would happen if these barriers to free and fair voting were removed? America would change forever--and that's what scares Republicans the most. As a side note, I find it ironic that the same people who scream "all lives matter" and "I don't see color"--suddenly see color just fine while denying voting rights to non-white voters. In Conclusion As the late great John Lewis once said, "Democracy is not a state--it is an act." We cannot have a more perfect union built on justice unless we have equal voting rights. And until we elect leaders who reflect the diversity of the American experience, we prevent our own progress. We must be in this for the long haul. Despite our exhaustion, we must continue to act on the local, state, and federal level to protect voting rights and thus protect our republic. Our mid-month deadline is tonight, and what we do today will determine what we can accomplish between now and Election Day.
#

Team, it’s Mark Kelly.
I’ve got two things for you here:
1. The Democratic National Convention starts next Monday. For us, and for a bunch of other folks who really care about our democracy, about defeating Trump, and winning this November — that’s a big deal.

2. Our mid-month deadline is tonight. So I need your help to hit our fundraising goal and give us the momentum we need heading into the convention next week. Because what we raise right now is going to tell us what we can expect for the rest of the month, and this month is going to determine how much we can do over the next three months to win.

So, with both of those things in mind... I’m asking you to chip in. We need a big day today, and I’m hoping I can count on you.
[**Please, if you can afford it, make a donation of anything — even $2 — before our mid-month deadline tonight.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-aug24.5UjS4b&refcode=em240815-1-120&t=1&akid=5851%2E6688874%2Edqn9pC)

Kamala Harris has picked Tim Walz as her running mate. As Minnesota governor, Tim Walz has made historic progress, including cutting taxes for working families ,expanding affordable health care and protecting women’s right to choose. From signing paid leave into law to codifying abortion rights in Minnesota — his track record proves he's a champion for working families and the best person to help move our country forward. He's been endorsed by leading Democrats like Barack Obama, Michelle Obama, Joe Biden and Kirsten Gillibrand. Now, we need to know where grassroots Democrats like YOU stand. That's why we're conducting a live approval poll. Friend: We're still missing your response, so please let us know before midnight tonight: Do you approve of Tim Walz? | | | | | * | = A note from Kirsten: Friend, I can’t thank you enough for standing by my side in the critical fights ahead of us. While Republicans only have to defend 10 seats in 2024, Democrats have to defend 23 — and if the GOP flips just two of them, it will deliver Senate control back to Mitch McConnell. Now, experts at FiveThirtyEight are saying that the GOP has a clear path to the majority. As right-wing special interests gear up to pour millions into flipping the Senate, we need to fight back right now. But I refuse to take a single cent from corporate PACs, which means I’m relying on your grassroots support. = And if you’d like to become a core member of my team and receive exclusive texts from my campaign, = Thank you, Kirsten Gillibrand

Fellow patriot,

Gabe Vasquez is suddenly trying to convince voters he cares about the illegal immigration crisis he has enabled and supported by visiting the Santa Teresa Port of Entry.

Let’s not be fooled – **this is a political campaign stunt.**

Now that we’re leading Gabe in the latest polls, he’s reading the writing on the wall and changing his tune.

But here’s the truth that he can’t hide from. Gabe Vasquez...

* Voted against the Secure the Border Act.
* Voted against the Laken Riley Act to detain criminal illegal aliens.
* Voted against denouncing Biden-Harris immigration policies.
* Voted against hiring more CBP agents and streamlining the asylum process.
* Voted against deploying improved technology to the southern border.

* Voted against removing Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas.

* Said the border wall was built by a “crooked, racist administration.”
* Applauded Biden for halting construction on the wall.

The truth is that **Gabe Vasquez is _against_ border security**, and no visit to the Port of Entry is going to trick us or the Border Security agents working there otherwise.

We won’t have secure borders until we rid Washington of anti-border security radical politicians like Gabe Vasquez and Kamala Harris.

| First off, I want to extend my humble and heartfelt gratitude to each voter, supporter, volunteer, donor, and friend that entrusted me with their vote and dedicated themselves to our campaign in each and every way. We could not have accomplished anything without you!
While the result of the election this week was not what we had hoped for, we have already seen lasting impact from our efforts. As we brought the extreme views of Mark Pocan out into the open, we reached many voters, even those who have never voted Republican before, by talking issues over party and personality.
These issues must lead the way to victory in the future! This week has in no way changed that we still have work to do to fight for our country. Candidates up and down the ballot running to win their races still need your help!
